+/**
+ * Returns the field name to show based on the active display mode.
+ * @param {any} fieldOrName - Input used by fieldDisplayName.
+ * @param {any} sourceFile - Raw source file name.
+ */
+function fieldDisplayParts(fieldOrName, sourceFile = "") {
+  const fallback = String(typeof fieldOrName === "string" ? fieldOrName : "");
+  if (!fieldOrName) return { raw: "", vanity: "", display: "", alternate: "" };
+  const field =
+    typeof fieldOrName === "string"
+      ? findFieldDisplayCandidate(fieldOrName, sourceFile)
+      : fieldOrName;
+  if (!field)
+    return {
+      raw: fallback,
+      vanity: fallback,
+      display: fallback,
+      alternate: "",
+    };
+  const raw = String(
+    field.fieldName ||
+      field.rawFieldName ||
+      fallback ||
+      field.name ||
+      field.label ||
+      "",
   );
+  const vanity = String(
+    field.vanityLabel ||
+      (field.name && field.name !== raw ? field.name : "") ||
+      field.label ||
+      raw,
+  );
+  const display =
+    fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity" ? vanity || raw : raw || vanity;
+  const alternate =
+    fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity"
+      ? raw !== display
+        ? raw
+        : ""
+      : vanity !== display
+        ? vanity
+        : "";
+  return { raw, vanity, display, alternate };

+/**
+ * Generates notes for a step when manual notes are not provided.
+ * @param {any} step - Logic step object being read or modified.
+ * @param {any} index - Zero-based index used for ordering or display.
+ */
+function noteText(step, index) {
+  return step.notes;
+}

+/**
+ * Returns enabled steps in hierarchy order.
+ */
+function orderedSteps() {
+  return hierarchicalStepEntries({ includeDisabled: false }).map(
+    (entry) => entry.step,
+  );
+}

+/**
+ * Builds data rows for the requirements preview and exports.
+ */
+function previewRows() {
+  syncAutoReferenceSteps?.();
+  return hierarchicalStepEntries({ includeDisabled: false }).map(
+    (entry, index) => ({
+      step: `${entry.number}`,
+      branch: entry.branchLabel,
+      analyst: analystLogic(entry.step),
+      developer: developerLogic(entry.step),
+      notes: noteText(entry.step, index),
+      level: entry.level,
+      source: entry.step.source || entry.step.params?.source_file || "",
+    }),
+  );

+
+/** Normalizes source and field identity values for matching. */
+function requirementsFieldIdentityPart(value) {
+  return String(value || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+
+/** Returns whether an audit field is custom, created, or calculated. */
+function requirementsIsCustomField(field) {
+  const type = requirementsFieldIdentityPart(field?.type);
+  return !!(
+    field?.custom ||
+    field?.created ||
+    field?.calculated ||
+    type === "custom" ||
+    type === "calculated" ||
+    requirementsFieldIdentityPart(field?.sourceFile) === "calculated field"
+  );
+}
+
+/** Resolves stable source identity while preserving key, file, and alias. */
+function requirementsSourceIdentity(value) {
+  const input = typeof value === "object" ? value || {} : { name: value };
+  if (typeof atlasResolveSourceIdentity === "function")
+    return atlasResolveSourceIdentity(input);
+  return {
+    sourceKey: input.sourceKey || input.sourceFile || input.name || "",
+    sourceFile: input.sourceFile || input.name || "",
+    alias: input.sourceAlias || input.alias || input.name || "",
+  };
+}
+
+/** Returns enabled structured field references with hierarchy-ordered Notes. */
+function requirementsLogicFieldReferences() {
+  const references = [];
+  hierarchicalStepEntries({ includeDisabled: false }).forEach(
+    (entry, order) => {
+      const step = entry.step;
+      const found =
+        typeof atlasLogicFieldReferences === "function"
+          ? atlasLogicFieldReferences([step])
+          : [];
+      found.forEach((reference) =>
+        references.push({
+          sourceFile: reference.sourceFile || "",
+          fieldName: reference.fieldName || "",
+          notes: String(step.notes || "").trim(),
+          order,
+        }),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+  return references;
+}

+/**
+ * Resolves a step type without mutating the stored step.
+ * @param {any} step - Logic step object being read for display.
+ */
+function completeStatementStepType(step) {
+  if (!step) return "";
+  if (step.step_type) return step.step_type;
+  if (step.type === "if" || step.type === "compare") return "if_then";
+  if (step.type === "source") return "reference_source";
+  if (step.type === "create") return "create_column";
+  return step.type || "";
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns whether an IF step has its own action instead of acting only as a parent gate.
+ * @param {any} step - Logic step object being read for display.
+ */
+function completeStatementHasIndependentAction(step) {
+  const params = step?.params || {};
+  const actionType = params.then_action_type || "freeform";
+  if (actionType === "display_text")
+    return !!(params.then_text || params.then_action);
+  if (actionType === "set_column_value")
+    return !!(
+      params.then_target_column ||
+      params.then_value_field ||
+      params.then_action
+    );
+  if (actionType === "do_not_display") return true;
+  return !!(params.then_action || step?.action);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Removes the leading IF-style keyword from a condition group.
+ * @param {string} text - Condition group text.
+ */
+function completeStatementStripIf(text) {
+  return String(text || "")
+    .trim()
+    .replace(/^(IF|ELSE IF)\s+/i, "")
+    .trim();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Wraps OR condition groups before they are AND-ed with inherited context.
+ * @param {string} text - Condition fragment.
+ */
+function completeStatementContextFragment(text) {
+  const value = String(text || "").trim();
+  if (!value) return "";
+  if (/\bOR\b/i.test(value) && !/^\(.+\)$/.test(value)) return `(${value})`;
+  return value;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Gets only the condition portion of an IF step for inherited preview context.
+ * @param {any} step - Logic step object being read for display.
+ * @param {boolean} grouped - Whether the condition will be combined with another condition.
+ */
+function completeStatementConditionContext(step, grouped = true) {
+  if (completeStatementStepType(step) !== "if_then") return "";
+  const conditionText =
+    typeof conditionGroupPlain === "function" ? conditionGroupPlain(step) : "";
+  const plain = completeStatementStripIf(conditionText);
+  return grouped ? completeStatementContextFragment(plain) : plain;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Combines parent context notes with the child note without overwriting either value.
+ * @param {string[]} contextNotes - Notes from hidden parent gate rows.
+ * @param {string} ownNote - Note for the displayed row.
+ */
+function completeStatementNotes(contextNotes = [], ownNote = "") {
+  return [
+    ...contextNotes
+      .filter(Boolean)
+      .map((note) => `Parent context note: ${note}`),
+    ownNote,
+  ]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join("\n");
+}
+
+/**
+ * Applies inherited IF context to an IF step's analyst statement while preserving the THEN/action text.
+ * @param {any} step - Logic step object being read for display.
+ * @param {string[]} inheritedContext - Parent IF condition fragments.
+ */
+function completeStatementAnalystLogic(step, inheritedContext = []) {
+  const base = analystLogic(step);
+  if (!inheritedContext.length || completeStatementStepType(step) !== "if_then")
+    return base;
+  const childCondition = completeStatementConditionContext(step, true);
+  if (!childCondition) return base;
+  const combinedCondition = `IF ${[...inheritedContext, childCondition].filter(Boolean).join(" AND ")}`;
+  const currentCondition =
+    typeof conditionGroupPlain === "function"
+      ? typeof ensureIfThenPrefix === "function"
+        ? ensureIfThenPrefix(conditionGroupPlain(step))
+        : conditionGroupPlain(step)
+      : "";
+  if (currentCondition && base.startsWith(currentCondition)) {
+    return `${combinedCondition}${base.slice(currentCondition.length)}`.trim();
+  }
+  const thenIndex = base.search(/\s+THEN\s+/i);
+  if (/^IF\b/i.test(base) && thenIndex > 0) {
+    return `${combinedCondition}${base.slice(thenIndex)}`.trim();
+  }
+  return base;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Builds display-only flattened rows for the Requirements Preview complete statement mode.
+ */
+function completeStatementPreviewRows() {
+  syncAutoReferenceSteps?.();
+  const entries = hierarchicalStepEntries({ includeDisabled: false });
+  const hasDisplayedChild = new Set(
+    entries.map((entry) => entry.step.parentId).filter(Boolean),
+  );
+  const contextByStepId = new Map();
+  const hiddenNotesByStepId = new Map();
+  const rows = [];
+
+  entries.forEach((entry) => {
+    const step = entry.step;
+    const parentContext = contextByStepId.get(step.parentId) || [];
+    const parentHiddenNotes = hiddenNotesByStepId.get(step.parentId) || [];
+    const stepType = completeStatementStepType(step);
+    const isConditional = stepType === "if_then";
+    const hasChildren = hasDisplayedChild.has(step.id);
+    const isGateOnly =
+      isConditional &&
+      hasChildren &&
+      !completeStatementHasIndependentAction(step);
+    const ownCondition = isConditional
+      ? completeStatementConditionContext(step, true)
+      : "";
+    const nextContext = ownCondition
+      ? [...parentContext, ownCondition]
+      : parentContext;
+    const ownNote = noteText(step, rows.length);
+    const nextHiddenNotes =
+      isGateOnly && ownNote
+        ? [...parentHiddenNotes, ownNote]
+        : parentHiddenNotes;
+
+    contextByStepId.set(step.id, nextContext);
+    hiddenNotesByStepId.set(step.id, nextHiddenNotes);
+
+    if (isGateOnly) return;
+
+    rows.push({
+      step: `${rows.length + 1}`,
+      branch: "Root",
+      analyst: isConditional
+        ? completeStatementAnalystLogic(step, parentContext)
+        : analystLogic(step),
+      developer: developerLogic(step),
+      notes: completeStatementNotes(parentHiddenNotes, ownNote),
+      level: 0,
+      source: step.source || step.params?.source_file || "",
     });
-  return dialog;
+  });
+
+  return rows;
 }

+/**
+ * Runs a function with optional Performance API marks/measures.
+ * @param {string} name - Friendly operation name for the performance timeline.
+ * @param {Function} fn - Function to execute.
+ */
+function atlasPerformanceDiagnosticsEnabled() {
+  return localStorage.getItem("atlasAlignPerfDiagnostics") === "true";
+}
+function atlasRecordPerformanceDiagnostic(name, duration) {
+  if (!atlasPerformanceDiagnosticsEnabled()) return;
+  const records =
+    state.atlasPerformanceDiagnostics ||
+    (state.atlasPerformanceDiagnostics = []);
+  records.push({ name, duration, activePage: atlasActivePage?.() || "" });
+  if (records.length > 250) records.splice(0, records.length - 250);
+}
+function atlasMeasure(name, fn) {
+  if (typeof fn !== "function") return undefined;
+  const canMeasure =
+    typeof performance !== "undefined" &&
+    typeof performance.mark === "function" &&
+    typeof performance.measure === "function";
+  if (!canMeasure) return fn();
+  const id = `${name}-${Date.now()}-${(atlasPerfSequence += 1)}`;
+  const start = `${id}-start`;
+  const end = `${id}-end`;
+  performance.mark(start);
+  const finish = () => {
+    performance.mark(end);
+    const entry = performance.measure(name, start, end);
+    atlasRecordPerformanceDiagnostic(name, entry.duration);
+    performance.clearMarks(start);
+    performance.clearMarks(end);
+  };
+  try {
+    const result = fn();
+    if (result && typeof result.then === "function") {
+      return result.finally(finish);
+    }
+    finish();
+    return result;
+  } catch (error) {
+    finish();
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Wraps a mutable render function once so later calls appear in browser performance tooling.
+ * @param {string} name - Friendly operation name.
+ * @param {Function} fn - Function to wrap.
+ */
+function atlasWrapWithPerf(name, fn) {
+  if (typeof fn !== "function" || fn.__atlasPerfWrapped) return fn;
+  const wrapped = function atlasPerformanceWrappedFunction(...args) {
+    return atlasMeasure(name, () => fn.apply(this, args));
+  };
+  wrapped.__atlasPerfWrapped = true;
+  wrapped.__atlasOriginal = fn;
+  return wrapped;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Flushes a batched render request using the smallest requested UI surface.
+ */
+function atlasFlushRequestedRender() {
+  if (!atlasPendingRenderFlags) return;
+  const flags = atlasPendingRenderFlags;
+  atlasPendingRenderFlags = null;
+  atlasRenderFrameId = 0;
+  if (flags.all) {
+    atlasMarkAllPagesDirty();
+    atlasRenderActivePage({ force: true });
+    return;
+  }
+  if (flags.header) renderHeader?.();
+  if (flags.sources) renderSources?.();
+  if (flags.fields) renderFields?.();
+  if (flags.steps) {
+    renderSteps?.({
+      includeSelectedStep: !flags.selectedStep,
+      includeLogicTable: !flags.logicTable,
     });
+  } else if (flags.selectedStep) renderSelectedStep?.();
+  if (flags.preview) {
+    atlasInvalidatePages(["preview"]);
+    atlasRenderPreviewWhenUseful();
+  }
+  if (flags.logicTable) {
+    atlasInvalidatePages(["preview"]);
+    if (atlasIsPreviewVisible()) renderLogicTablePreviewRows?.();
+  }
+  if (flags.validation) renderValidationPanel?.();
+  if (flags.flowSelect) renderFlowSelect?.();
 }

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Source-field math calculation helpers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+const ATLAS_SOURCE_MATH_OPERATORS = ["+", "-", "*", "/"];
+
+/**
+ * Parses Create Column source-field math operations from params or a JSON string.
+ * @param {any} params - Step params object or raw JSON string.
+ */
+function parseSourceMathOperations(params = {}) {
+  const raw = Array.isArray(params)
+    ? params
+    : typeof params === "string"
+      ? params
+      : params.source_math_json ||
+        params.compareMathJson ||
+        params.compare_math_json ||
+        params.compareMath ||
+        params.math_json;
+  if (!raw) return [];
+  try {
+    const parsed = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : JSON.parse(raw);
+    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
+    return parsed
+      .map((item) => {
+        const operandType =
+          String(item?.operandType || item?.operand_type || "number").trim() ===
+          "field"
+            ? "field"
+            : "number";
+        const operator = String(item?.operator || "").trim();
+        const operand = String(item?.operand ?? "").trim();
+        const operandSourceFile = String(
+          item?.operandSourceFile || item?.operand_source_file || "",
+        ).trim();
+        const operandFieldName = String(
+          item?.operandFieldName || item?.operand_field_name || "",
+        ).trim();
+        const operandSourceAlias = String(
+          item?.operandSourceAlias ||
+            item?.operand_source_alias ||
+            sourceAliasFor?.(operandSourceFile) ||
+            operandSourceFile ||
+            "",
+        ).trim();
+        return {
+          id:
+            item?.id ||
+            uid?.("math") ||
+            `math_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
+          operator,
+          operandType,
+          operand,
+          operandSourceFile,
+          operandSourceAlias,
+          operandFieldName,
+        };
+      })
+      .filter(
+        (item) =>
+          ATLAS_SOURCE_MATH_OPERATORS.includes(item.operator) &&
+          (item.operandType === "field"
+            ? item.operandFieldName
+            : item.operand) &&
+          !(
+            item.operator === "/" &&
+            item.operandType !== "field" &&
+            Number(item.operand) === 0
+          ),
+      );
+  } catch (_err) {
+    return [];
+  }
 }

+/**
+ * Converts a decimal-place value into a safe non-negative integer string.
+ * @param {any} value - Raw decimal-place value.
+ * @param {string} fallback - Fallback when value is blank or invalid.
+ */
+function atlasDecimalPlacesValue(value, fallback = "0") {
+  const raw = String(value ?? "").trim();
+  if (!raw) return fallback;
+  const numeric = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
+  return Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric >= 0 ? String(numeric) : fallback;

+/**

+function renderDefaultLogicPillToken(value) {

+/**
+ * Renders analyst logic with visually styled field/source pills.
+ * @param {any} text - Input used by renderLogicWithPills.
+ */
+function renderLogicWithPills(text) {
+  const parts = String(text || "").split(/("[^"]+")/g);
+  return parts
+    .map((part) => {
+      if (!part.startsWith('"') || !part.endsWith('"')) return esc(part);

+      return renderLogicPillToken(value);
+    })
+    .join("");

+function unwrapSingleExpression(expression = "") {

+    const char = value[index];
+    if (char === "(") depth += 1;
+    if (char === ")") depth -= 1;
+    if (depth === 0 && index < value.length - 1) return value;

+// ATLAS-MATH-OPERATIONS-UPDATE:BEGIN
+// Canonical math model and shared helpers. Kept in the existing rendering module
+// so later classic-script overrides can reuse one parser and serializer.
+function atlasRawMathValue(value = {}) {
+  if (Array.isArray(value) || typeof value === "string") return value;
+  return (
+    value.source_math_json ||
+    value.then_math_json ||
+    value.compareMathJson ||
+    value.compare_math_json ||
+    value.compareMath ||
+    value.math_json ||
+    []
+  );
+}
+
+function atlasParseRawMathOperations(value = {}) {
+  const raw = atlasRawMathValue(value);
+  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw;
+  if (!String(raw || "").trim()) return [];
+  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
+  if (!Array.isArray(parsed))
+    throw new Error("Math operations must be a JSON array.");
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+function atlasNormalizeMathOperation(
+  item = {},
+  { preserveInvalid = true } = {},
+) {
+  const rawOperator = String(item.operator || "").trim();
+  const operator = rawOperator === "_" ? "*" : rawOperator;
+  const operandType =
+    String(item.operandType || item.operand_type || "number").trim() === "field"
+      ? "field"
+      : "number";
+  const operandSourceFile = String(
+    item.operandSourceFile || item.operand_source_file || "",
+  ).trim();
+  const normalized = {
+    id: item.id || uid("math"),
+    operator,
+    operandType,
+    operand: String(item.operand ?? "").trim(),
+    operandSourceFile,
+    operandSourceAlias: String(
+      item.operandSourceAlias ||
+        item.operand_source_alias ||
+        sourceAliasFor?.(operandSourceFile) ||
+        operandSourceFile ||
+        "",
+    ).trim(),
+    operandFieldName: String(
+      item.operandFieldName || item.operand_field_name || "",
+    ).trim(),
+  };
+  if (preserveInvalid) return normalized;
+  if (!ATLAS_SOURCE_MATH_OPERATORS.includes(normalized.operator)) return null;
+  if (
+    operandType === "field" ? !normalized.operandFieldName : !normalized.operand
+  )
+    return null;
+  if (
+    normalized.operator === "/" &&
+    operandType === "number" &&
+    Number(normalized.operand) === 0
+  )
+    return null;
+  return normalized;
+}
+
+function atlasSerializeMathOperations(operations = []) {
+  return JSON.stringify(
+    (operations || []).map((item) => atlasNormalizeMathOperation(item)),
+  );

+function atlasLooksLikeIdentifierField(field = {}) {
+  const text = [
+    field.fieldName,

+function atlasIsNumericField(field = {}) {
+  if (!field || atlasLooksLikeIdentifierField(field)) return false;
+  const typeText = [
+    field.fieldType,
+    field.type,
+    field.dataType,
+    field.data_type,
+  ]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase();
+  const formatText = [field.fieldFormat, field.format, field.displayFormat]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase();
+  const categoryText = [field.dataCategory, field.category]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase();
+  const numericToken =
+    /(^|\b)(number|numeric|decimal|integer|float|double|currency|amount|salary|rate)(\b|$)/;
+  const explicitCalculatedNumeric =
+    !!(field.calculated || field.created || field.custom) &&
+    numericToken.test(`${typeText} ${formatText} ${categoryText}`);
+  return (
+    explicitCalculatedNumeric ||
+    numericToken.test(typeText) ||
+    numericToken.test(formatText)
+  );
+}

+function atlasValidateMathOperations(value = {}, options = {}) {
+  const issues = [];
+  let operations;
+  try {
+    operations = atlasParseRawMathOperations(value);
+  } catch (error) {
+    return [{ level: "error", code: "malformed_json", message: error.message }];
+  }
+  operations.forEach((raw, index) => {
+    const operation = atlasNormalizeMathOperation(raw);
+    const position = index + 1;
+    if (!ATLAS_SOURCE_MATH_OPERATORS.includes(operation.operator))
+      issues.push({
+        level: "error",
+        code: "operator",
+        message: `Operation ${position} has an unsupported operator.`,
+      });
+    if (operation.operandType === "number") {
+      if (!operation.operand)
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "operand",
+          message: `Operation ${position} is missing a numeric operand.`,
+        });
+      else if (!/^[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)$/.test(operation.operand))
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "number",
+          message: `Operation ${position} has an invalid numeric value.`,
+        });
+      if (
+        operation.operator === "/" &&
+        operation.operand &&
+        Number(operation.operand) === 0
+      )
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "divide_zero",
+          message: `Operation ${position} cannot divide by zero.`,
+        });
+    } else {
+      if (!operation.operandSourceFile)
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "source",
+          message: `Operation ${position} is missing an operand source.`,
+        });
+      if (!operation.operandFieldName)
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "field",
+          message: `Operation ${position} is missing an operand field.`,
+        });
+      const field = atlasMathOperandField(operation);
+      if (operation.operandFieldName && !field)
+        issues.push({
+          level: "error",
+          code: "unresolved_field",
+          message: `Operation ${position} uses an operand field that cannot be resolved.`,
+        });
+      else if (field && atlasLooksLikeIdentifierField(field))
+        issues.push({
+          level: "warn",
+          code: "math_operand_identifier",
+          message: `Operation ${position} uses identifier field "${operation.operandFieldName}" from "${operation.operandSourceAlias || operation.operandSourceFile}". Identifier values may be stored as numbers but generally should not be used in arithmetic.`,
+        });
+      else if (field && !atlasIsNumericField(field)) {
+        const typeOrFormat = [
+          field.fieldType,
+          field.type,
+          field.dataType,
+          field.data_type,
+          field.fieldFormat,
+          field.format,
+          field.displayFormat,
+        ]
+          .filter(Boolean)
+          .join(" / ");
+        issues.push({
+          level: "warn",
+          code: typeOrFormat
+            ? "math_operand_non_numeric_metadata"
+            : "math_operand_numeric_metadata_missing",
+          message: typeOrFormat
+            ? `Operation ${position} uses "${operation.operandFieldName}" from "${operation.operandSourceAlias || operation.operandSourceFile}", which is identified as "${typeOrFormat}". Verify that its values can be converted to numbers before applying this operation.`
+            : `Operation ${position} uses "${operation.operandFieldName}" from "${operation.operandSourceAlias || operation.operandSourceFile}", but its field metadata does not confirm that it contains numeric values. Verify the field before implementation.`,
+        });
       }
-    });
+      if (operation.operator === "/" && operation.operandFieldName)
+        issues.push({
+          level: "warn",
+          code: "field_divisor",
+          message: `Operation ${position} uses a field divisor. Generated logic returns blank/NULL when the divisor is zero.`,
+        });
+    }
+  });
+  if (options.baseSourceFile && options.baseFieldName) {
+    const field = atlasFindFieldRecord(
+      options.baseSourceFile,
+      options.baseFieldName,
+    );
+    if (!field || !atlasIsNumericField(field))
+      issues.push({
+        level: "error",
+        code: "base_nonnumeric",
+        message:
+          "The calculation base field must be explicitly cataloged as numeric and not an identifier.",
+      });
   }
+  return issues;
 }

+function atlasStringTransformDeveloperExpression(config, { sql = false } = {}) {

+    ? sqlBracketIdentifier(config.sourceField || "[source field]")

+/**
+ * Opens the IndexedDB database used for saved flows.
+ */
+function openDb() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = indexedDB.open(ATLAS_DB_NAME, ATLAS_DB_VERSION);
+    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
+      const db = request.result;
+      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE))
+        db.createObjectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
+    };
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+  });
 }

+/**
+ * Reads all saved flow records from IndexedDB.
+ */
+async function dbAll() {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readonly");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).getAll();
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result || []);
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Writes a saved flow or autosave record to IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} record - IndexedDB record to write.
+ */
+async function dbPut(record) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readwrite");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).put(record);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads a saved flow by id from IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ */
+async function dbGet(id) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readonly");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).get(id);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * Deletes a saved flow from IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ */
+async function dbDelete(id) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readwrite");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).delete(id);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();

+async function fetchJsonGracefully(path, label) {
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch(path, { cache: "no-store" });
+    if (!response.ok)
+      throw new Error(`${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
+    return await response.json();

+      `${label || path} could not be loaded from ${path}.`,
+    );
+    return null;

+/**

+function sourceCatalogKey(sourceOrEntry = {}) {

+/**
+ * Builds a concise display name for source catalog rows and picker options.
+ * @param {any} source - Source file record.

+function sourceCatalogDisplayName(source = {}) {

+    source.sourceFile || source.name || sourceCatalogKey(source);

+  return alias && alias !== sourceFile
+    ? `${sourceFile} — ${alias}`

+/**
+ * Loads and caches detailed source metadata from a source index entry.
+ * @param {any} entry - Input used by loadSourceFileDetail.
+ */
+async function loadSourceFileDetail(entry) {
+  if (!entry?.sourceFile && !entry?.alias && !entry?.file) return null;
+  const entryKey = sourceCatalogKey(entry);
+  if (entryKey && repoLibraryState.sourceFileCache.has(entryKey))
+    return repoLibraryState.sourceFileCache.get(entryKey);
+  const json = await fetchJsonGracefully(
+    entry.file,
+    entry.sourceFile || entry.alias || entry.file,
+  );
+  const detail = json || {
+    version: 1,
+    sourceFile: entry.sourceFile,
+    alias: entry.alias || entry.sourceFile,
+    fieldCount: entry.fieldCount || 0,
+    fields: [],
+  };
+
+  detail.sourceFile =
+    detail.sourceFile || entry.sourceFile || entry.alias || entry.file;
+  detail.alias = detail.alias || entry.alias || detail.sourceFile;
+  detail.catalogFile = entry.file || detail.catalogFile || "";
+  detail.sourceKey = sourceCatalogKey({ ...entry, ...detail });
+  detail.fields = Array.isArray(detail.fields) ? detail.fields : [];
+  repoLibraryState.sourceFileCache.set(detail.sourceKey, detail);
+  return detail;

+/**

+function normalizeAssignmentUser(user) {
+  if (!user || typeof user !== "object" || Array.isArray(user)) return null;
+  const id = String(user.id || "").trim();
+  const username = String(user.username || "").trim();
+  if (!id && !username) return null;
+  return {
+    id,
+    username,
+    fullName: String(user.fullName || "").trim(),
+    email: String(user.email || "").trim(),
+    avatar: String(user.avatar || "").trim() || null,
+  };
+}
+function normalizeAssignmentUsers(users) {
+  const seenIds = new Set(),
+    seenNames = new Set();
+  return (Array.isArray(users) ? users : [])
+    .map(normalizeAssignmentUser)
+    .filter((user) => {
+      if (!user) return false;
+      const name = user.username.toLowerCase();
+      if ((user.id && seenIds.has(user.id)) || (name && seenNames.has(name)))
+        return false;
+      if (user.id) seenIds.add(user.id);
+      if (name) seenNames.add(name);
+      return true;
+    });
+}
+function normalizeAuditAssignments(assignments) {
+  const value =
+    assignments &&
+    typeof assignments === "object" &&
+    !Array.isArray(assignments)
+      ? assignments
+      : {};
+  return {
+    assigned: normalizeAssignmentUsers(value.assigned),
+    backup: normalizeAssignmentUsers(value.backup),
+    developer: normalizeAssignmentUsers(value.developer),
+  };
+}
+function normalizeLoadedAudit(audit, sourceKind = "unknown") {

+  normalized.sources = Array.isArray(normalized.sources)
+    ? normalized.sources
+    : [];

+    source.name =
+      source.sourceKey ||
+      source.name ||
+      source.sourceFile ||
+      source.alias ||
+      "";

+    source.alias = source.alias || source.sourceFile;
+  });
+  normalized.fields = Array.isArray(normalized.fields) ? normalized.fields : [];

+  normalized.steps.forEach((step, index) =>
+    normalizeCatalogStep?.(step, index),
+  );
+  return normalized;

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

+/**
+ * Flattens catalog metadata into searchable text.
+ * @param {any} value - Value to process or assign.
+ */
+function atlasCatalogTextValue(value) {
+  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
+  if (value && typeof value === "object")
+    return Object.values(value).map(atlasCatalogTextValue).join(" ");
+  return value == null ? "" : String(value);
+}
+/**
+ * Renders metadata lists as small HTML labels.
+ * @param {any} values - Input used by atlasCatalogListHtml.
+ */
+function atlasCatalogListHtml(values) {
+  const items = (
+    Array.isArray(values) ? values : String(values || "").split(",")
+  )
+    .map((item) => String(item || "").trim())
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  return items.length
+    ? items.map((item) => `<span class="badge">${esc(item)}</span>`).join(" ")
+    : "";
+}
+/**
+ * Renders one metadata label/value line.
+ * @param {any} label - Human-readable label.
+ * @param {any} value - Value to process or assign.
+ */
+function atlasCatalogMetaLine(label, value) {
+  const text = atlasCatalogTextValue(value).trim();
+  return text
+    ? `<div class="small"><strong>${esc(label)}:</strong> ${esc(text)}</div>`
+    : "";
+}
+/**
+ * Builds searchable text for a catalog field.
+ * @param {any} field - Field record.
+ */
+function atlasCatalogFieldSearchText(field) {
+  return [

+    field.name,

+    field.transformationLogic,
+    field.translationLogic,
+    field.schemaLocation,
+    field.developerNotes,
+    field.developerJoinNotes,
+    atlasCatalogTextValue(field.sampleValues),
+    atlasCatalogTextValue(field.matchingKeys),
+    atlasCatalogTextValue(field.governance),
+  ]
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+/**
+ * Builds searchable text for a source and its fields.

+function sourceSearchText(source) {

+let activeSourceLibraryTab = "all";
+function sourceSystem(source) {
+  const text = `${source.sourceFile || ""} ${source.alias || ""}`.toLowerCase();
+  if (
+    text.includes("workday") ||
+    text.includes("wd.") ||
+    text.includes("wd ") ||
+    text.startsWith("wd")
+  )
+    return "workday";
+  if (
+    text.includes("sap") ||
+    text.includes("sap.") ||
+    /^zhr|^zhre|^hi\d|^pa\s/i.test(source.sourceFile || "")
+  )
+    return "sap";
+  return "other";
+}
+function selectedSourceSet() {
+  return new Set(
+    (state.audit.sources || [])
+      .map((source) => atlasSourceMutationKey(source))
+      .filter(Boolean),
+  );
+}
+function sourceMatchesSearch(source, query) {
+  if (!query) return true;
+  return [
+    source.sourceFile,
+    source.alias,
+    ...(source.fields || []).flatMap((field) => [
+      field.fieldName,
+      field.vanityLabel,
+      field.label,
+    ]),
+  ]
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .includes(query);
+}

+let activeSelectedSourceName = "";
+
+function firstLetter(value) {
+  const c = String(value || "")
+    .trim()
+    .charAt(0)
+    .toUpperCase();
+  return /[A-Z]/.test(c) ? c : "#";
+}
+function alphaSortItems(items, getName) {
+  return [...items].sort((a, b) =>
+    String(getName(a) || "").localeCompare(
+      String(getName(b) || ""),
+      undefined,
+      { sensitivity: "base", numeric: true },
+    ),
+  );
+}
+function alphaLetters(items, getName) {
+  return [
+    ...new Set(
+      alphaSortItems(items, getName).map((item) => firstLetter(getName(item))),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+function scrollContactsLetter(containerSelector, letter) {
+  const container = document.querySelector(containerSelector);
+  const target = container?.querySelector(
+    `[data-alpha-letter="${CSS.escape(letter)}"]`,
+  );
+  if (container && target)
+    container.scrollTo({
+      top: target.offsetTop - container.offsetTop,
+      behavior: "smooth",
+    });
+}

+function allAuditLibraryItems() {
+  const items = [];
+  (repoLibraryState?.audits || []).forEach((audit) =>
+    items.push({
+      value: `repo:${audit.id}`,
+      title: audit.name || audit.id,
+      detail: audit.description || audit.file || "",
+      kind: "Repo Audit",
+    }),
+  );
+  (state.savedFlows || []).forEach((flow) =>
+    items.push({
+      value: `local:${flow.id}`,
+      title: flow.name || "Saved audit",
+      detail: flow.updatedAt
+        ? `Saved ${new Date(flow.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}`
+        : "Saved in this browser",
+      kind: "Saved Audit",
+    }),
+  );
+  if (typeof workbookState !== "undefined" && workbookState.loaded)
+    (workbookState.auditSheets || []).forEach((name) =>
+      items.push({
+        value: `workbook:${name}`,
+        title: name,
+        detail: "Workbook audit sheet",
+        kind: "Workbook Import",
+      }),
+    );
+  return alphaSortItems(items, (item) => item.title);

+function filteredSourceEntries() {

+function atlasSourceUsageState(source) {

+function atlasSourceLibraryPill(source) {
+  const usage = atlasSourceUsageState(source);
+  const alias = source.alias || source.sourceFile;
+  const query = ($("sourceFieldSearch")?.value || "").toLowerCase().trim();
+  const matchedFields = query
+    ? (source.fields || []).filter((field) =>
+        atlasCatalogFieldSearchText(field).includes(query),
+      )
+    : [];
+  const matchHtml = matchedFields.length
+    ? `<div class="source-library-field-matches"><strong>Matching fields:</strong>${matchedFields
+        .slice(0, 5)
+        .map((field) => {
+          const name =
+            field.vanityLabel ||
+            field.label ||
+            field.fieldName ||
+            field.rawFieldName ||
+            field.name ||
+            "Field";
+          const format = atlasCatalogTextValue(field.fieldFormat).trim();
+          const samples = atlasCatalogTextValue(field.sampleValues).trim();
+          const keys = (
+            Array.isArray(field.matchingKeys)
+              ? field.matchingKeys
+              : String(field.matchingKeys || "").split(",")
+          )
+            .map((item) => String(item || "").trim())
+            .filter(Boolean);
+          const related = keys.length
+            ? sourceCatalogEntries()
+                .filter(
+                  (candidate) =>
+                    sourceCatalogKey(candidate) !== sourceCatalogKey(source),
+                )
+                .flatMap((candidate) =>
+                  (candidate.fields || [])
+                    .filter((candidateField) => {
+                      const candidateKeys = (
+                        Array.isArray(candidateField.matchingKeys)
+                          ? candidateField.matchingKeys
+                          : String(candidateField.matchingKeys || "").split(",")
+                      )
+                        .map((item) =>
+                          String(item || "")
+                            .trim()
+                            .toLowerCase(),
+                        )
+                        .filter(Boolean);
+                      return keys.some((key) =>
+                        candidateKeys.includes(key.toLowerCase()),
+                      );
+                    })
+                    .map(
+                      (candidateField) =>
+                        `${candidate.sourceFile}: ${candidateField.vanityLabel || candidateField.label || candidateField.fieldName || candidateField.rawFieldName || candidateField.name || "Field"}`,
+                    ),
+                )
+                .filter(
+                  (value, index, values) => values.indexOf(value) === index,
+                )
+                .slice(0, 4)
+            : [];
+          return `<div class="source-library-field-match"><span>${esc(name)}</span>${format ? `<small><strong>Format:</strong> ${esc(format)}</small>` : ""}${samples ? `<small><strong>Samples:</strong> ${esc(samples)}</small>` : ""}${related.length ? `<small><strong>Related mappings:</strong> ${related.map(esc).join("; ")}</small>` : ""}</div>`;
+        })
+        .join(
+          "",
+        )}${matchedFields.length > 5 ? `<small>+${matchedFields.length - 5} more matching fields</small>` : ""}</div>`
+    : "";
+  const badges = [
+    usage.logicDerived
+      ? '<span class="source-inclusion-badge logic">Used in Logic</span>'
+      : "",
+  ]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join("");
+  return `<article class="audit-source-picker-pill ${usage.included ? "included" : "available"}"${usage.included ? ` style="--source-pill-color:${esc(usage.color)}"` : ""}>
+    <span class="source-color-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
+    <button type="button" class="audit-source-picker-main" data-source-detail-name="${esc(sourceCatalogKey(source))}">
+      <strong>${esc(source.sourceFile)}</strong>
+      ${alias && alias !== source.sourceFile ? `<span>${esc(alias)}</span>` : ""}
+      <small>${esc(sourceSystem(source).toUpperCase())} · ${source.fields?.length || 0} fields</small>
+      ${matchHtml}
+    </button>
+    <span class="source-inclusion-badges">${badges}</span>
+    <button type="button" class="btn small source-library-action-button ${usage.manualSelected ? "danger source-library-remove-button" : "primary source-library-add-button"}" data-source-action="${usage.manualSelected ? "remove" : "add"}" data-source-key="${esc(source.sourceKey || source.sourceFile)}">${usage.manualSelected ? "Remove" : "Use"}</button>
+  </article>`;

+const atlasCaptureGuidedFieldsBeforeMathUpdate = atlasCaptureGuidedFields;
+atlasCaptureGuidedFields = function atlasCaptureGuidedFieldsWithMath(
+  root,
+  step,
+) {
+  root.querySelectorAll("[data-math-editor]").forEach((editor) => {
+    const hidden = editor.querySelector("[data-math-json]");
+    if (hidden)
+      hidden.value = atlasSerializeMathOperations(
+        atlasMathOperationsFromContainer(editor),
+      );
+  });
+  atlasCaptureGuidedFieldsBeforeMathUpdate(root, step);
+  const conditionRows = [...root.querySelectorAll(".guided-condition-row")];
+  if (!conditionRows.length) return;
+  const conditions = conditionRows.map((row, index) => {
+    const get = (field) =>
+      row.querySelector(`[data-condition-field="${field}"]`)?.value || "";
+    const sourceFile = get("sourceFile");
+    const compareSourceFile = get("compareSourceFile") || sourceFile;
+    const mathEditor = row.querySelector('[data-math-param="compareMathJson"]');
+    const compareMathJson = mathEditor
+      ? atlasSerializeMathOperations(
+          atlasMathOperationsFromContainer(mathEditor),
+        )
+      : get("compareMathJson");
+    return {
+      id: row.dataset.conditionId || uid("cond"),
+      connector: index === 0 ? "IF" : get("connector") || "AND",
+      conditionType: "row_compare",
+      sourceFile,
+      sourceAlias: sourceAliasFor(sourceFile),
+      fieldName: get("fieldName"),
+      operator: get("operator") || "is equal to",
+      valueMode: get("valueMode") || "values",
+      compareValue: get("compareValue"),
+      compareSourceFile,
+      compareSourceAlias: sourceAliasFor(compareSourceFile),
+      compareFieldName: get("compareFieldName"),
+      expression: get("expression"),
+      compareMathJson,
+    };
+  });
+  atlasWriteLiveEditorConditions(step, conditions);
+};

+function atlasSelectedAuditSources() {
+  const catalogSources = sourceCatalogEntries();

+    const identity = atlasResolveSourceIdentity(selectedSource, catalogSources);
+    const catalogSource = identity.ambiguous
+      ? {}

+    return {
+      ...catalogSource,
+      ...selectedSource,
+      sourceKey: selectedSource.sourceKey || identity.sourceKey,
+      sourceFile:
+        selectedSource.sourceFile ||
+        identity.sourceFile ||
+        selectedSource.name ||
+        selectedSource.sourceKey ||
+        "",
+      alias: selectedSource.alias || identity.alias,
+      fields: catalogSource.fields?.length
+        ? catalogSource.fields
+        : selectedSource.fields || [],
+    };
+  });

+function atlasResolveSelectedSource(sourceLike) {
+  const selectedSources = atlasSelectedAuditSources();
+  const input =
+    typeof sourceLike === "string" ? { name: sourceLike } : sourceLike || {};
+  const stableKeys = [
+    input.sourceReferenceId,
+    input.sourceKey,
+    input.baseSourceKey,
+    input.id,
+  ]
+    .map(atlasNormalizedSourceIdentity)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const stableMatches = selectedSources.filter((source) => {
+    const sourceStableKeys = [
+      source.sourceReferenceId,
+      source.sourceKey,
+      source.baseSourceKey,
+      source.id,
+    ]
+      .map(atlasNormalizedSourceIdentity)
+      .filter(Boolean);
+    return stableKeys.some((key) => sourceStableKeys.includes(key));
+  });
+  if (stableMatches.length === 1) return stableMatches[0];
+  if (stableMatches.length > 1) return null;
+  const fallbackKeys = [input.name, input.sourceFile, input.alias]
+    .map(atlasNormalizedSourceIdentity)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const fallbackMatches = selectedSources.filter((source) => {
+    const sourceFallbackKeys = [source.name, source.sourceFile, source.alias]
+      .map(atlasNormalizedSourceIdentity)
+      .filter(Boolean);
+    return fallbackKeys.some((key) => sourceFallbackKeys.includes(key));
+  });
+  return fallbackMatches.length === 1 ? fallbackMatches[0] : null;

+function atlasSourceStableKey(sourceLike) {
+  const source = atlasResolveSelectedSource(sourceLike) || sourceLike || {};
+  if (typeof source === "string") return atlasNormalizedSourceIdentity(source);
+  return String(
+    source.sourceReferenceId ||

+      source.id ||
+      source.sourceFile ||
+      source.name ||
+      "",
+  ).trim();

+function atlasEnsureAuditSourceColors() {
+  const sources = state.audit.sources || [];
+  const palette =
+    Array.isArray(SOURCE_COLOR_PALETTE) && SOURCE_COLOR_PALETTE.length
+      ? SOURCE_COLOR_PALETTE
+      : ["#4d6fa9", "#b54b4b", "#2e7d5b", "#a66b11", "#7c5aa6"];
+  const used = new Set(sources.map((source) => source.color).filter(Boolean));
+  sources.forEach((source) => {
+    if (source.color) return;
+    source.color =
+      palette.find((color) => !used.has(color)) ||
+      palette[sources.indexOf(source) % palette.length];
+    used.add(source.color);
+  });
+  return sources;
+}
+
+function atlasSelectedSourceColor(sourceLike) {
+  atlasEnsureAuditSourceColors();
+  return atlasResolveSelectedSource(sourceLike)?.color || "";
+}

+function atlasIsCustomField(field) {
+  if (!field) return false;
+  const category = String(
+    field.dataCategory || field.category || field.type || field.fieldType || "",
+  ).toLowerCase();
+  return !!(
+    field.calculated ||
+    field.created ||
+    field.custom ||
+    category.includes("calculated") ||
+    category.includes("custom column") ||
+    category.includes("created column")
+  );

+function renderMiniPicker() {
+  document
+    .querySelector(".visual-picker-modal-backdrop.dynamic-mini-picker")
+    ?.remove();
+  if (!visualPickerState) return;
+  atlasEnsureAuditSourceColors();
+  const options =
+    visualPickerState.kind === "source"
+      ? pickerSourceOptions()
+      : pickerFieldOptions(visualPickerState.sourceFile);
+  const query = visualPickerState.query || "";
+  const filtered = atlasSortedPickerItems(
+    options.filter((option) =>
+      `${option.sourceFile} ${option.sourceAlias} ${option.fieldName} ${option.label}`
+        .toLowerCase()
+        .includes(query.toLowerCase()),
+    ),
+  );
+  const groups = new Map();
+  filtered.forEach((option) => {
+    const group =
+      atlasFieldPickerSortMode === "alpha"
+        ? firstLetter(option.label || option.fieldName || option.sourceFile)
+        : visualPickerState.kind === "source"
+          ? "Selected Sources"
+          : option.sourceFile;
+    if (!groups.has(group)) groups.set(group, []);
+    groups.get(group).push(option);
+  });
+
+  const selectedValue = String(
+    visualPickerState.target?.dataset?.currentValue ||
+      visualPickerState.target?.querySelector?.("strong")?.textContent ||
+      "",
+  ).trim();
+  const groupMarkup = [...groups.entries()]
+    .map(([group, items]) => {
+      const rows = items
+        .map((item) => {
+          const isSource = visualPickerState.kind === "source";
+          const value = isSource ? item.sourceFile : item.fieldName;
+          const selected = value === selectedValue;
+          const primary = isSource ? item.sourceAlias : item.label;
+          const secondary = isSource
+            ? item.sourceFile
+            : `${item.sourceAlias || item.sourceFile}.${item.fieldName}`;
+          const classes = [
+            "visual-picker-option",
+            isSource ? "source-picker-option" : "field-picker-option",
+            item.customField ? "custom-field-pill" : "",
+            selected ? "selected" : "",
+          ]
+            .filter(Boolean)
+            .join(" ");
+          return `<button type="button" class="${classes}" data-mini-picker-value="${esc(value)}" data-mini-picker-source="${esc(item.sourceFile)}" data-source-key="${esc(item.sourceKey || atlasSourceStableKey(item.sourceFile))}" style="--source-color:${esc(item.sourceColor)}" aria-pressed="${selected ? "true" : "false"}"><span class="source-color-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="visual-picker-option-copy"><strong>${esc(primary)}</strong><small>${esc(secondary)}</small></span>${selected ? '<span class="selection-status">Selected</span>' : ""}</button>`;
+        })
+        .join("");
+      return `<section class="visual-picker-group"><div class="visual-picker-group-title"><strong>${esc(group)}</strong><span class="badge blue">${items.length}</span></div><div class="visual-picker-option-list">${rows}</div></section>`;
+    })
+    .join("");

+  const root = document.createElement("div");

+  root.innerHTML = `<div class="visual-picker-modal"><div class="visual-picker-modal-header"><div><h2 class="visual-picker-modal-title">${visualPickerState.kind === "source" ? "Choose Selected Source File" : "Choose Field"}</h2><p class="visual-picker-modal-subtitle">Only sources selected for this audit are available here.</p></div><button type="button" class="visual-picker-close-button" data-close-mini-picker aria-label="Close picker">×</button></div><div class="visual-picker-search-row"><input data-mini-picker-search value="${esc(query)}" placeholder="Search selected sources and fields..."><div class="mini-picker-sort-toggle"><button type="button" class="secondary small ${atlasFieldPickerSortMode === "source" ? "active" : ""}" data-picker-sort="source">Sort by Source</button><button type="button" class="secondary small ${atlasFieldPickerSortMode === "alpha" ? "active" : ""}" data-picker-sort="alpha">A-Z</button></div></div><div class="visual-picker-content">${groupMarkup || '<div class="contacts-empty">No selected source fields match the current search.</div>'}</div></div>`;

+function atlasFieldMatchForSource(value, sourceLike) {
+  const normalized = String(value || "").trim();
+  const source = atlasSelectedAuditSources().find(
+    (candidate) =>
+      atlasSourceStableKey(candidate) === atlasSourceStableKey(sourceLike),
+  );
+  if (!source) return null;
+  const field = (source.fields || []).find((item) => {
+    const parts = fieldDisplayParts(item, source.sourceFile);
+    return [
+      parts.raw,
+      parts.vanity,
+      parts.display,
+      `${source.sourceFile}.${parts.raw}`,
+      `${source.alias || source.sourceFile}.${parts.raw}`,
+    ].includes(normalized);
+  });
+  return field
+    ? {
+        sourceFile: source.sourceFile,
+        sourceKey: atlasSourceStableKey(source),
+        color: atlasSelectedSourceColor(source),
+        kind: atlasIsCustomField(field) ? "custom" : "field",
+        field,
+      }
+    : null;
+}
+
+function atlasSourceMatchForValue(value, preferredSource = null) {
+  const normalized = String(value || "").trim();
+  if (!normalized) return null;
+  const direct = atlasResolveSelectedSource(normalized);
+  if (direct) {
+    return {
+      sourceFile: direct.sourceFile || direct.name,
+      sourceKey: atlasSourceStableKey(direct),
+      color: atlasSelectedSourceColor(direct),
+      kind: "source",
+    };
+  }
+  if (preferredSource) {
+    const preferredField = atlasFieldMatchForSource(
+      normalized,
+      preferredSource,
+    );
+    if (preferredField) return preferredField;
+  }
+  for (const source of atlasSelectedAuditSources()) {
+    const fieldMatch = atlasFieldMatchForSource(normalized, source);
+    if (fieldMatch) return fieldMatch;
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+renderLogicWithPills = function atlasRenderLogicWithSourceAndFieldPills(text) {
+  const parts = String(text || "").split(/("[^"]+")/g);
+  let activeSource = null;
+  return parts
+    .map((part) => {
+      if (!part.startsWith('"') || !part.endsWith('"')) return esc(part);
+      const value = part.slice(1, -1);
+      const match = atlasSourceMatchForValue(value, activeSource);
+      if (match?.kind === "source") activeSource = match;
+      const klass =
+        match?.kind === "custom"
+          ? "logic-pill custom-field-token"
+          : match?.kind === "field"
+            ? "logic-pill field-pill-token field-token"
+            : "logic-pill source-pill source-token";
+      const style = match
+        ? ` style="--pill-bg:${esc(match.color)};--pill-color:${esc(match.color)};--source-color:${esc(match.color)}"`
+        : "";
+      const dot = match
+        ? `<span class="source-color-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>`
+        : "";
+      const displayValue =
+        match?.kind === "field" || match?.kind === "custom"
+          ? fieldDisplayParts(match.field || value, match.sourceFile).display
+          : value;
+      return `<span class="${klass}" data-source-key="${esc(match?.sourceKey || "")}"${style}>${dot}${esc(displayValue)}</span>`;
+    })
+    .join("");
+};

+function atlasActionAvailability(step) {
+  const reference =
+    !!step?.autoGeneratedReference || step?.step_type === "reference_source";
+  return {
+    edit: !reference,
+    indent: !reference,
+    outdent: !reference && !!step?.parentId,
+    addChild: true,
+    addAfter: !reference,
+    duplicate: !reference,
+    delete: !reference,
+  };
+}

+function atlasAddStepAfter(stepId) {
+  capture();
+  const index = state.audit.steps.findIndex((step) => step.id === stepId);
+  const current = state.audit.steps[index];
+  const nextStep = {
+    id: uid("step"),
+    enabled: true,
+    parentId: current?.parentId || null,
+    branchType: current?.parentId ? current.branchType || "then" : "root",
+    sortOrder: (Number(current?.sortOrder) || index + 1) + 0.1,
+    title: "IF / THEN",
+    type: "if",
+    step_type: "if_then",
+    source: current?.source || state.audit.sources?.[0]?.name || "",
+    field: "",
+    action: "",
+    notes: "",
+    conditions: [
+      { id: uid("cond"), field: "", operator: "is equal to", value: "" },
+    ],
+    params: {},
+  };
+  normalizeCatalogStep?.(nextStep);
+  if (typeof atlasInitializeNewIfThenAction === "function") {
+    delete nextStep.params.then_action_type;
+    atlasInitializeNewIfThenAction(nextStep);
+    nextStep.params.then_action_type =
+      nextStep.params.then_action_type || "freeform";
+  }
+  if (index >= 0) state.audit.steps.splice(index + 1, 0, nextStep);
+  else state.audit.steps.push(nextStep);
+  state.audit.steps.forEach((step, order) => {
+    if (!step.autoGeneratedReference) step.sortOrder = order + 1;
+  });
+  state.selectedStepId = nextStep.id;
+  renderAll();
+  scheduleAutosave();
+}
+
+function atlasDuplicateStepById(stepId) {
+  capture();
+  const step = state.audit.steps.find((item) => item.id === stepId);
+  if (!step || step.autoGeneratedReference) return;
+  const copy = structuredClone(step);
+  copy.id = uid("step");
+  copy.autoGeneratedReference = false;
+  copy.conditions = (copy.conditions || []).map((condition) => ({
+    ...condition,
+    id: uid("cond"),
+  }));
+  const index = state.audit.steps.indexOf(step);
+  state.audit.steps.splice(index + 1, 0, copy);
+  state.audit.steps.forEach((item, order) => {
+    if (!item.autoGeneratedReference) item.sortOrder = order + 1;
+  });
+  state.selectedStepId = copy.id;
+  renderAll();
+  scheduleAutosave();
+}

+function atlasResetRuleMenuPosition(panel) {

+  panel.style.removeProperty("top");

+function atlasRuleMenuTriggerIsVisible(menuToggle, rulesViewport) {
+  if (!menuToggle?.isConnected || !rulesViewport?.isConnected) return false;
+  const triggerRect = menuToggle.getBoundingClientRect();
+  const viewportRect = rulesViewport.getBoundingClientRect();
+  return (
+    triggerRect.bottom > viewportRect.top &&
+    triggerRect.top < viewportRect.bottom &&
+    triggerRect.right > viewportRect.left &&
+    triggerRect.left < viewportRect.right
+  );
+}
+function atlasPositionRuleMenu(menuToggle, panel) {
+  const rulesViewport = menuToggle?.closest("#stepsList");
+  if (
+    !panel?.isConnected ||
+    !atlasRuleMenuTriggerIsVisible(menuToggle, rulesViewport)
+  ) {
+    atlasCloseRuleMenus();
+    return false;
+  }
+  const gap = 6;
+  const edge = 8;
+  const viewportTop = edge;
+  const viewportBottom = window.innerHeight - edge;
+  const viewportLeft = edge;
+  const viewportRight = window.innerWidth - edge;
+  const triggerRect = menuToggle.getBoundingClientRect();
+
+  panel.hidden = false;
+  panel.style.position = "fixed";
+  panel.style.left = "0px";
+  panel.style.top = "0px";
+  panel.style.right = "auto";
+  panel.style.visibility = "hidden";
+  panel.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(0, viewportBottom - viewportTop)}px`;
+  panel.dataset.positioned = "true";
+  if (panel.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.append(panel);
+
+  const panelRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
+  const menuWidth = panelRect.width;
+  const menuHeight = panelRect.height;
+  const spaceBelow = viewportBottom - triggerRect.bottom - gap;
+  const spaceAbove = triggerRect.top - viewportTop - gap;
+  const opensBelow = menuHeight <= spaceBelow;
+  const opensAbove = menuHeight <= spaceAbove;
+  const placement = opensBelow
+    ? "below"
+    : opensAbove
+      ? "above"
+      : spaceBelow >= spaceAbove
+        ? "below"
+        : "above";
+  const availableHeight = Math.max(
+    0,
+    placement === "below" ? spaceBelow : spaceAbove,
+  );
+  const maxHeight = Math.min(menuHeight, availableHeight);
+  const measuredHeight = Math.min(menuHeight, maxHeight);
+  const top =
+    placement === "below"
+      ? triggerRect.bottom + gap
+      : triggerRect.top - gap - measuredHeight;
+  const left = Math.max(
+    viewportLeft,
+    Math.min(triggerRect.right - menuWidth, viewportRight - menuWidth),
+  );
+
+  if (
+    !Number.isFinite(top) ||
+    !Number.isFinite(left) ||
+    maxHeight <= 0 ||
+    viewportRight <= viewportLeft
+  ) {
+    atlasCloseRuleMenus();
+    return false;
+  }
+  panel.style.maxHeight = `${Math.round(maxHeight)}px`;
+  panel.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
+  panel.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
+  panel.style.removeProperty("visibility");
+  return true;
+}

+const atlasReferenceSyncBase = syncAutoReferenceSteps;
+syncAutoReferenceSteps = function syncAutoReferenceStepsWithDescendantCleanup(
+  ...args
+) {
+  const before = (state.audit.steps || []).map((step) => ({
+    id: step.id,
+    parentId: step.parentId || null,
+    reference:
+      !!step.autoGeneratedReference || step.step_type === "reference_source",
+  }));
+  const result = atlasReferenceSyncBase(...args);
+  const remaining = new Set((state.audit.steps || []).map((step) => step.id));
+  const removeIds = new Set(
+    before
+      .filter((step) => step.reference && !remaining.has(step.id))
+      .map((step) => step.id),
+  );
+  let changed = true;
+  while (changed) {
+    changed = false;
+    before.forEach((step) => {
+      if (
+        step.parentId &&
+        removeIds.has(step.parentId) &&
+        !removeIds.has(step.id)
+      ) {
+        removeIds.add(step.id);
+        changed = true;
+      }
+    });
+  }
+  if (removeIds.size)
+    state.audit.steps = (state.audit.steps || []).filter(
+      (step) => !removeIds.has(step.id),
+    );
+  if (state.selectedStepId && removeIds.has(state.selectedStepId))
+    state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps[0]?.id || null;
+  return result;
+};

+function atlasConditionValueInputs(container) {
+  return container
+    ? [...container.querySelectorAll("[data-condition-value-item]")]
+    : [];
+}
+
+function atlasUniqueConditionValues(container) {
+  const seen = new Set();
+  return atlasConditionValueInputs(container)
+    .map((input) => String(input.value || "").trim())
+    .filter((value) => {
+      if (!value || seen.has(value)) return false;
+      seen.add(value);
+      return true;
+    });
+}
+
+function atlasUpdateConditionValueHidden(container) {
+  if (!container) return;
+  const hidden = container.querySelector(
+    '[data-condition-field="compareValue"]',
+  );
+  if (!hidden) return;
+  hidden.value = atlasUniqueConditionValues(container).join("\n");
+}

+function atlasConditionValueIsDuplicate(input, editor) {
+  const value = String(input?.value || "").trim();
+  if (!value || !editor) return false;
+  return atlasConditionValueInputs(editor).some(
+    (candidate) =>
+      candidate !== input && String(candidate.value || "").trim() === value,
+  );
+}

+function atlasFocusNextConditionValue(input, editor) {
+  const inputs = atlasConditionValueInputs(editor);
+  const index = inputs.indexOf(input);
+  if (index >= 0 && inputs[index + 1]) {
+    inputs[index + 1].focus();
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const list = editor?.querySelector(".condition-values-list");
+  if (!list) return;
+  list.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", atlasConditionValueRows(""));
+  const nextInput = atlasConditionValueInputs(editor).at(-1);
+  nextInput?.focus();

+document.addEventListener(
+  "keydown",
+  (event) => {
+    const input = event.target.closest?.("[data-condition-value-item]");
+    if (!input || (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== "Tab")) return;
+
+    if (event.key === "Tab") {
+      // Commit before the browser advances focus. Exact matching is intentional:
+      // comparison values are case-sensitive, so "ABC" and "abc" are distinct.
+      atlasCommitConditionValueInput(input, { clearDuplicate: true });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    event.preventDefault();
+    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
+    const result = atlasCommitConditionValueInput(input);
+    if (result.duplicate) {
+      input.select();
+      status?.("That exact comparison value is already listed.", "warn");
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!result.committed) return;
+    atlasFocusNextConditionValue(input, result.editor);
+  },
+  true,
+);

+/* Follow-up Logic Step Editor refinements */
+function atlasOperatorOptionsForValueMode(valueMode, selectedOperator = "") {
+  const mode = valueMode || "values";
+  const operators =
+    mode === "blank"
+      ? ["is blank/null", "is not blank/null"]
+      : mode === "field"
+        ? [
+            "is equal to",
+            "is not equal to",
+            "is greater than",
+            "is greater than or equal to",
+            "is less than",
+            "is less than or equal to",
+          ]
+        : mode === "expression"
+          ? ["matches expression", "does not match expression"]
+          : [
+              "is equal to",
+              "is not equal to",
+              "contains",
+              "does not contain",
+              "starts with",
+              "ends with",
+            ];
+  return optionsHtml(
+    operators,
+    operators.includes(selectedOperator) ? selectedOperator : operators[0],
+  );
+}

+function atlasCreateRuleOfType(stepType, { afterStepId = "" } = {}) {
+  const type = atlasNewRuleTypeOptions().some(([value]) => value === stepType)
+    ? stepType
+    : "if_then";
+  const sourceFile = atlasDefaultSourceForNewRule();
+  const step = {
+    id: uid("step"),
+    enabled: true,
+    parentId: null,
+    branchType: "root",
+    sortOrder: (state.audit.steps || []).length + 1,
+    title: atlasNewRuleStepLabel(type),
+    type: legacyTypeFromStepType?.(type) || "if",
+    step_type: type,
+    source: sourceFile,
+    field: "",
+    action: "",
+    notes: "",
+    conditions:
+      type === "if_then"
+        ? [{ id: uid("cond"), field: "", operator: "is equal to", value: "" }]
+        : [],
+    params: sourceFile
+      ? {
+          source_file: sourceFile,
+          source_alias: sourceAliasFor?.(sourceFile) || sourceFile,
+        }
+      : {},
+  };
+  normalizeCatalogStep?.(step);
+  if (type === "if_then") {
+    delete step.params.then_action_type;
+    atlasInitializeNewIfThenAction(step);
+    step.params.then_action_type = step.params.then_action_type || "freeform";
+  }
+  if (type === "if_then" && !step.params.conditions_json) {
+    step.params.conditions_json = JSON.stringify([
+      defaultGuidedCondition?.(step) || {
+        id: uid("cond"),
+        connector: "IF",
+        conditionType: "row_compare",
+        sourceFile,
+        sourceAlias: sourceAliasFor?.(sourceFile) || sourceFile,
+        fieldName: "",
+        operator: "is equal to",
+        valueMode: "values",
+        compareValue: "",
+      },
+    ]);
+  }
+  const steps = state.audit.steps || [];
+  const index = afterStepId
+    ? steps.findIndex((item) => item.id === afterStepId)
+    : -1;
+  if (index >= 0) steps.splice(index + 1, 0, step);
+  else steps.push(step);
+  state.audit.steps = steps;
+  atlasReindexManualRules();
+  state.selectedStepId = step.id;
+  atlasCloseNewRuleTypeMenu();
+  atlasRequestStructuralStepRender?.();
+  scheduleAutosave();
+  status?.(`Added ${atlasNewRuleStepLabel(type)} rule.`, "ok");
+  return step;
+}

+function atlasMigrateLegacyInverseStep(step, sourceStep) {
+  if (!step || !sourceStep) return step;
+  step.step_type = "if_then";
+  step.type = "if";
+  step.parentId = sourceStep.parentId || null;
+  step.branchType =
+    sourceStep.branchType || (sourceStep.parentId ? "then" : "root");
+  step.title = "Linked Inverse";
+  step.inverseOfStepId = sourceStep.id;
+  step.params =
+    step.params && typeof step.params === "object" ? step.params : {};
+  step.params.inverse_else = "Yes";
+  step.params.inverse_of_step_id = sourceStep.id;
+  delete step.params.include_else_branch;
+  return step;
+}

+function syncInverseElseStepsForSource(stepId) {

+function createInverseElseStepForIf(stepId) {
+  atlasCommitLiveEditor?.({ rerender: false });
+  const sourceStep = stepById?.(stepId);
+  if (
+    !sourceStep ||
+    sourceStep.autoGeneratedReference ||
+    sourceStep.step_type !== "if_then" ||
+    sourceStep.params?.inverse_else === "Yes"
+  ) {
+    status?.(
+      "Create Linked Inverse is available only for editable source IF / THEN steps.",
+      "warn",
+    );
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  let inverseStep = atlasLinkedInverseForSource(stepId);
+  if (!inverseStep) {
+    const legacy = (state.audit.steps || []).find(
+      (step) =>
+        step.step_type === "else" &&
+        (step.inverseOfStepId === stepId ||
+          step.params?.inverse_of_step_id === stepId),
+    );
+    if (legacy) inverseStep = atlasMigrateLegacyInverseStep(legacy, sourceStep);
+  }
+
+  if (!inverseStep) {
+    capture?.();
+    normalizeCatalogStep?.(sourceStep);
+    const conditions = atlasCloneInverseConditionsForTarget(sourceStep);
+    const sourceFile = atlasSourceForInverseStep(sourceStep, conditions);
+    const sourceAlias = sourceAliasFor?.(sourceFile) || sourceFile;
+    inverseStep = {
+      id: uid("step"),
+      enabled: true,
+      parentId: sourceStep.parentId || null,
+      branchType:
+        sourceStep.branchType || (sourceStep.parentId ? "then" : "root"),
+      sortOrder: atlasInverseElseSortOrder(sourceStep),
+      title: "Linked Inverse",
+      type: "if",
+      step_type: "if_then",
+      source: sourceFile,
+      field: "",
+      action: "",
+      notes: "",
+      conditions: atlasConditionSummaries(conditions),
+      autoGeneratedReference: false,
+      inverseOfStepId: sourceStep.id,
+      params: {
+        inverse_else: "Yes",
+        inverse_of_step_id: sourceStep.id,
+        source_file: sourceFile,
+        source_alias: sourceAlias,
+        conditions_json: JSON.stringify(conditions),
+        then_action_type: "freeform",
+        then_action: "",
+      },
+    };
+    const sourceIndex = state.audit.steps.indexOf(sourceStep);
+    state.audit.steps.splice(
+      sourceIndex >= 0 ? sourceIndex + 1 : state.audit.steps.length,
+      0,
+      inverseStep,
+    );

+function atlasUserInitials(user) {
+  const source = String(user?.fullName || user?.username || "").trim();
+  if (!source) return "?";
+  const parts = source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+  return (
+    parts.length > 1 ? parts[0][0] + parts.at(-1)[0] : source.slice(0, 2)
+  ).toUpperCase();
+}
+function atlasDisplayUser(user) {
+  return String(user?.fullName || user?.username || "Unknown user");
+}
+function atlasUserMatches(left, right) {
+  const leftId = String(left?.id || "").trim(),
+    rightId = String(right?.id || "").trim();
+  if (leftId && rightId) return leftId === rightId;
+  const a = String(left?.username || "")
+      .trim()
+      .toLowerCase(),
+    b = String(right?.username || "")
+      .trim()
+      .toLowerCase();
+  return !!a && a === b;
+}
+function atlasAssignmentRole(role) {
+  return ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_ROLES.includes(role) ? role : "";
+}
+function atlasEnsureAuditAssignments() {
+  const assignments = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(state.audit?.assignments) || {
+    assigned: [],
+    backup: [],
+    developer: [],
+  };
+  state.audit.assignments = assignments;
+  return assignments;
+}
+function atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(role) {
+  renderAssignmentEditor();
+  renderMyAudits();
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["my-audits", "overview"]);
+  scheduleAutosave?.();
+  globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.invalidate?.();
+  const roleLabel =
+    {
+      assigned: "Assigned Analysts",
+      backup: "Backup Analysts",
+      developer: "Developers",
+    }[role] || "Audit Assignments";
+  status?.(`${roleLabel} updated.`, "ok");
+}
+function atlasAddAuditAssignment(role, user) {
+  const validRole = atlasAssignmentRole(role);
+  const normalizedUser = normalizeAssignmentUser?.(user);
+  if (!validRole || !normalizedUser || user?.disabled === true) return false;
+  const assignments = atlasEnsureAuditAssignments();
+  if (
+    assignments[validRole].some((value) =>
+      atlasUserMatches(value, normalizedUser),
+    )
+  )
+    return false;
+  assignments[validRole].push(normalizedUser);
+  atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(validRole);
+  return true;
+}
+function atlasRemoveAuditAssignment(role, identity) {
+  const validRole = atlasAssignmentRole(role);
+  if (!validRole) return false;
+  const assignments = atlasEnsureAuditAssignments();
+  const current = assignments[validRole];
+  const next = current.filter((user) => !atlasUserMatches(user, identity));
+  if (next.length === current.length) return false;
+  assignments[validRole] = next;
+  atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(validRole);
+  return true;
+}
+function atlasAuditMembership(audit) {
+  const current = state.currentUser,
+    assignments = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(audit?.assignments) || {
+      assigned: [],
+      backup: [],
+      developer: [],
+    };
+  if (!current || state.currentUserStatus !== "ready")
+    return { assigned: false, backup: false, developer: false, role: "Other" };
+  const assigned = assignments.assigned.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+  const backup = assignments.backup.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+  const developer = assignments.developer.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+
   return {
-    counts,
-    complete,
-    approvalEligible: complete && counts.approved === counts.total,
-    returnEligible:
-      complete && counts.requestChanges + counts.needsDiscussion > 0,
-    earlyReturnEligible:
-      missingNotes.length === 0 &&
-      counts.requestChanges + counts.needsDiscussion > 0,
-    blockingItems: [
-      ...direct.filter((item) => !item.decision),
-      ...missingNotes,
-    ].map((item) => ({
-      sectionKey: item.sectionKey,
-      stableItemKey: item.stableItemKey,
-      displayLabel: item.displayLabel,
-    })),
+    assigned,
+    backup,
+    developer,
+    role: assigned
+      ? "Assigned Analyst"
+      : backup
+        ? "Backup Analyst"
+        : developer
+          ? "Developer"
+          : "Other",
   };
 }

+function atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(...lists) {
+  const result = [];
+  lists.flat().forEach((user) => {
+    if (!user || result.some((item) => atlasUserMatches(item, user))) return;
+    result.push(user);
+  });
+  return result;

+async function atlasLoadRecentAssignmentUsers(role, query = "") {
+  const search = state.assignmentUserSearch[role];
+  if (!search) return;
+  search.controller?.abort?.();
+  search.controller = new AbortController();
+  search.query = String(query || "").trim();
+  search.loading = true;
+  search.error = "";
+  search.source = "recent";
+  renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  try {
+    const payload = await atlasSearchCachedUsers(search.query, {
+      size: 20,
+      signal: search.controller.signal,
+    });
+    const items = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+    atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(items);
+    state.assignmentRecentUsers = items;
+    search.results = items;
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error.name !== "AbortError") search.error = error.message;
+  } finally {
+    search.loading = false;
+    renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  }

+async function atlasPerformDatabaseWrite(changeSummary) {
+  if (window.ATLASAuditReview?.isActive?.()) return;
+  capture?.();

+  const snapshot = structuredClone(state.audit);

+    state.auditPersistence.auditId === auditId &&
+    !!state.auditPersistence.revisionId;

+  state.auditPersistence.saving = true;
+  atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(
+    exists ? "Saving to database…" : "Creating database audit…",
+  );

-        sourceRevisionId: Number(a.current_revision_id),
+        method: exists ? "PUT" : "POST",

-  });

+      "ok",

+  } catch (error) {
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.error = error;
+    if (
+      error.status === 409 &&
+      error.code === "AUDIT_PENDING_APPROVAL_LOCKED"
+    ) {
+      atlasClearDatabaseWriteTimers();
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration =
+        atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration;
+      atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(error.message);
+      await window.ATLASWorkflow?.refresh?.();
+      return false;
+    }
+    if (error.status === 409) {
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict = true;
+      state.auditPersistence.conflict = {
+        currentRevisionId: error.currentRevisionId,
+      };
+      atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(
+        "Database save conflict. Review the conflict before retrying.",
+      );
+      atlasOpenConflictDialog?.(error);
+      return false;
+    }
+    atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(`Database save failed: ${error.message}`);
+    throw error;
+  } finally {
+    if (state.audit?.id === auditId) state.auditPersistence.saving = false;
+  }

+async function atlasRefreshDeletedAudits() {
+  if (!state.currentUser?.access?.canManageDeletedAudits) return [];
+  state.deletedAuditsStatus = "loading";
+  renderMyAudits();
+  try {
+    const p = await atlasAuditApi("/api/admin/audits/deleted");
+    state.deletedAudits = Array.isArray(p.audits) ? p.audits : [];
+    state.deletedAuditsStatus = "ready";
+    state.deletedAuditsError = "";
+    renderMyAudits();
+    return state.deletedAudits;
+  } catch (e) {
+    state.deletedAuditsStatus = "error";
+    state.deletedAuditsError = e.message;
+    renderMyAudits();
+    throw e;
+  }
+}
+async function atlasRestoreDeletedAudit(id) {
+  const a = (state.deletedAudits || []).find((x) => x.id === id);
+  if (!a || !confirm(`Restore "${a.name}" to the active Audit Library?`))
+    return;
+  await atlasAuditApi(`/api/admin/audits/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/restore`, {
+    method: "POST",
+  });
+  await Promise.all([
+    atlasRefreshDeletedAudits(),
+    atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits(),
+  ]);
+  status("Audit restored.", "ok");
+}
+async function atlasPermanentlyDeleteAudit(id) {
+  const a = (state.deletedAudits || []).find((x) => x.id === id);
+  if (!a || !confirm(`Permanently delete "${a.name}"? This cannot be undone.`))
+    return;
+  await atlasAuditApi(`/api/admin/audits/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
+    method: "DELETE",
+  });
+  await atlasRefreshDeletedAudits();
+  status("Audit permanently deleted.", "ok");

+/** Display Fields page. */
+const atlasOriginalRequirementsFieldRows = requirementsFieldRows;
+function atlasDisplayPart(value) {
+  return String(value || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+function atlasDisplayKey(value) {
+  if (value?.canonicalKey) return atlasDisplayPart(value.canonicalKey);
+  return `${atlasDisplayPart(value?.sourceKey || value?.sourceFile || value?.uniqueId || "calculated field")}::${atlasDisplayPart(value?.fieldName || value?.fieldTitle || value?.name)}`;
+}
+function atlasDisplayCreatedFieldContext(row) {
+  const title = atlasDisplayPart(
+    row?.fieldTitle || row?.fieldName || row?.name,
+  );
+  if (!title || typeof atlasCreatedFieldEntries !== "function") return null;
+  const matches = atlasCreatedFieldEntries({ includeUnavailable: true }).filter(
+    (item) => atlasDisplayPart(item.fieldName || item.rawFieldName) === title,
+  );
+  if (matches.length !== 1) return null;
+  const created = matches[0],
+    step = stepById?.(created.creatorStepId),
+    referenceSource = step?.parentId
+      ? atlasPickerReferenceSource?.(stepById?.(step.parentId)) || ""
+      : "",
+    identity = referenceSource
+      ? requirementsSourceIdentity(referenceSource)
+      : {
+          sourceKey: "calculated-field",
+          sourceFile: "Calculated Field",
+          alias: "Calculated Field",
+        };
+  return {
+    canonicalKey: `calculated:${created.creatorStepId}`,
+    creatorStepId: created.creatorStepId,
+    identity,
+    sourceColor: referenceSource
+      ? atlasSelectedSourceColor?.(identity.sourceKey || identity.sourceFile) ||
+        created.sourceColor ||
+        "#7da2d8"
+      : "#7da2d8",
+  };
+}
+function atlasDisplayCanonicalKey(row, calculated) {

+function atlasSaveDisplayField(row, displayed) {

     };

"Yes" : "No"}</td><td><label class="display-fields-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" data-display-field-toggle="${esc(row.key)}" aria-label="Display ${esc(row.vanityLabel || row.fieldTitle)}" ${row.displayed ? +  function meaningfulAction(step) {
+    const item = object(step);
+    const params = object(item.params);
+    const type = string(params.then_action_type || params.action_type).trim();
+    if (string(item.action).trim()) return true;
+    if (type === "do_not_display") return true;
+    if (type === "display_text")
+      return !blank(params.then_text) && !blank(params.then_output_column);
+    if (type === "set_column_value")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) && !blank(params.then_value_field)
+      );
+    if (type === "set_column_calculation")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) && !blank(params.then_value_field)
+      );
+    if (type === "set_column_string_transform")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) &&
+        !blank(params.then_string_source_field) &&
+        !blank(params.then_string_operation)
+      );
+    if (type === "freeform") return !blank(params.then_action);
+    return false;
+  }
