+export async function returnAuditReview(
+  pool,
+  { sessionId, expectedVersion, user, early = false },
+) {
+  const client = await pool.connect();
+  try {
+    await client.query("BEGIN");
+    const sessionResult = await client.query(
+      `SELECT s.*,r.document,q.request_status,q.selected_approver_user_id,q.selected_approver_username,a.current_revision_id,a.current_approval_request_id,a.workflow_status FROM atlas_audit_review_sessions s JOIN atlas_audit_revisions r ON r.id=s.submitted_revision_id JOIN atlas_audit_approval_requests q ON q.id=s.approval_request_id JOIN atlas_audits a ON a.id=s.audit_id WHERE s.id=$1 FOR UPDATE OF s,q,a`,
+      [sessionId],
+    );
+    if (!sessionResult.rowCount)
+      throw fail(404, "Review session is unavailable.");
+    const session = sessionResult.rows[0];
+    if (session.session_status !== "Draft")
+      throw fail(409, "This review has already been finalized.");
+    if (Number(session.draft_version) !== Number(expectedVersion))
+      throw fail(409, "Review draft changed in another session.", {
+        draftVersion: Number(session.draft_version),
+      });
+    await authority(client, {
+      auditId: session.audit_id,
+      requestId: session.approval_request_id,
+      user,
+      lock: true,
+    });
+    const items = await sessionItems(client, sessionId);
+    const summary = finalSummary(items);
+    const returnEligible = early
+      ? summary.earlyReturnEligible
+      : summary.returnEligible;
+    if (!returnEligible)
+      throw fail(
+        409,
+        early
+          ? "The review is not eligible for Early Send Back."
+          : "The review is not eligible to be returned.",
+        {
+          finalSummary: summary,
+        },
+      );
+    const analyst = assignedAnalyst(session.document);
+    if (!analyst?.username)
+      throw fail(409, "The assigned analyst is unavailable.");
+    const metadata = {
+      reviewSessionId: Number(session.id),
+      submittedRevisionId: Number(session.submitted_revision_id),
+      counts: summary.counts,
+      outcome: "Returned",
+    };
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audit_review_sessions SET session_status='Returned',final_outcome='Returned',completed_at=now(),returned_analyst_user_id=$2,returned_analyst_username=$3,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1`,
+      [sessionId, analyst.id, analyst.username],
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audit_approval_requests SET request_status='Denied',decided_at=now(),reviewer_response='Returned through item-level review' WHERE id=$1 AND request_status='Pending'`,
+      [session.approval_request_id],
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_inbox_items SET item_status='Resolved',resolved_at=COALESCE(resolved_at,now()) WHERE audit_id=$1 AND approval_request_id=$2 AND item_status='Actionable'`,
+      [session.audit_id, session.approval_request_id],
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audits SET workflow_status='Draft Revision',current_approval_request_id=NULL,current_approval_id=NULL,revision_cycle_number=revision_cycle_number+1 WHERE id=$1`,
+      [session.audit_id],
+    );
+    await client.query(
+      `INSERT INTO atlas_inbox_items(recipient_user_id,recipient_username,audit_id,approval_request_id,review_session_id,item_type,item_status,display_metadata) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'Returned Review','Actionable',$6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(review_session_id) WHERE item_type='Returned Review' DO NOTHING`,
+      [
+        analyst.id,
+        analyst.username,
+        session.audit_id,
+        session.approval_request_id,
+        sessionId,
+        JSON.stringify(metadata),

+      `INSERT INTO atlas_audit_activity_events(audit_id,event_type,actor_user_id,actor_username,approval_request_id,source_revision_id,metadata) VALUES($1,'approval.review_returned',$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)`,
+      [

+        reviewerKey(user),
+        session.approval_request_id,
+        session.submitted_revision_id,
+        JSON.stringify({
+          reviewSessionId: Number(sessionId),
+          analyst,
+          counts: summary.counts,
+        }),
+      ],
+    );
+    await client.query("COMMIT");
+    return {
+      reviewSessionId: Number(sessionId),
+      workflowStatus: "Draft Revision",
+      outcome: "Returned",
+      analyst,
+      finalSummary: summary,
+      earlySendBack: Boolean(early),
+    };
+  } catch (error) {
+    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
+    throw error;
+  } finally {
+    client.release();
+  }

+export async function getReturnedReviewFeedback(pool, { sessionId, user }) {

-**Purpose:** Supporting project file for tutorial-global.js.
+function carryEquivalent(previous, current) {
+  if (
+    !previous ||
+    !current ||
+    previous.decision !== "Approve" ||
+    current.isDirect === false
+  )
+    return false;
+  if (
+    previous.sectionKey !== current.sectionKey ||
+    previous.itemType !== current.itemType ||
+    (previous.canonicalObjectKey || previous.stableItemKey) !==
+      (current.canonicalObjectKey || current.stableItemKey) ||
+    previous.semanticFingerprint !== current.semanticFingerprint
+  )
+    return false;
+  if (
+    current.isDeleted ||
+    current.changeReasonCodes?.some((code) =>
+      [
+        "object_added",
+        "object_removed",
+        "field_added",
+        "field_removed",
+        "content_changed",
+        "parent_changed",
+        "ancestor_changed",
+        "order_changed",
+        "severity_changed",
+        "applicability_changed",
+      ].includes(code),
+    )
+  )
+    return false;
+  if ((previous.parentItemKey || null) !== (current.parentItemKey || null))
+    return false;
+  if ((previous.linkedItemKey || null) !== (current.linkedItemKey || null))
+    return false;
+  if (
+    current.itemType === "logic-step" &&
+    Number(previous.canonicalOrder) !== Number(current.canonicalOrder)
+  )
+    return false;
+  if (
+    current.itemType === "audit-issue" &&
+    (previous.severity || null) !== (current.severity || null)
+  )
+    return false;
+  return true;
+}

+export async function carryForwardReviewItemsWithClient(
+  client,
+  { auditId, requestId, submittedRevisionId, document },
+) {
+  const previousResult = await client.query(
+    `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_review_sessions WHERE audit_id=$1 AND session_status='Returned' AND submitted_revision_id<>$2 ORDER BY completed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1`,
+    [auditId, submittedRevisionId],
+  );
+  if (!previousResult.rowCount)
+    return { sourceReviewSessionId: null, carried: 0 };
+  const previousSession = previousResult.rows[0];
+  const newSessionResult = await client.query(
+    `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_review_sessions WHERE approval_request_id=$1 AND submitted_revision_id=$2 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,
+    [requestId, submittedRevisionId],
+  );
+  if (!newSessionResult.rowCount)
+    return { sourceReviewSessionId: Number(previousSession.id), carried: 0 };
+  const previous = await sessionItems(client, previousSession.id);
+  const baselineRevision = await client.query(
+    `SELECT document FROM atlas_audit_revisions WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2`,
+    [previousSession.submitted_revision_id, auditId],
+  );
+  const current = buildAuditReviewItems(document, {
+    auditId,
+    baselineDocument: baselineRevision.rows[0]?.document || null,
+  });
+  const priorByKey = new Map();
+  for (const item of previous) {
+    const key =
+      item.canonicalObjectKey || `${item.sectionKey}|${item.stableItemKey}`;
+    if (priorByKey.has(key)) priorByKey.set(key, null);
+    else priorByKey.set(key, item);
+  }
+  let carried = 0;
+  for (const item of current) {
+    const prior = priorByKey.get(
+      item.canonicalObjectKey || `${item.sectionKey}|${item.stableItemKey}`,
+    );
+    if (!carryEquivalent(prior, item)) continue;
+    const updated = await client.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audit_review_items SET decision='Approve',reviewer_note=NULL,decided_at=now(),carried_forward=TRUE,source_review_item_id=$4,updated_at=now() WHERE review_session_id=$1 AND section_key=$2 AND stable_item_key=$3 AND decision IS NULL`,
+      [
+        newSessionResult.rows[0].id,
+        item.sectionKey,
+        item.stableItemKey,
+        prior.id,
+      ],
+    );
+    carried += updated.rowCount;
+  }
+  await client.query(
+    `UPDATE atlas_audit_review_sessions SET source_review_session_id=$2,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1`,
+    [newSessionResult.rows[0].id, previousSession.id],
+  );
+  return { sourceReviewSessionId: Number(previousSession.id), carried };
+}

+export async function finalizeApprovedAuditReview(
+  pool,
+  { sessionId, expectedVersion, versionTitle, user },
+) {
+  const title = text(versionTitle);
+  if (!title) throw fail(400, "Version title is required.");
+  const client = await pool.connect();
+  try {
+    await client.query("BEGIN");
+    // Lock order: review session, audit, request, submitted revision.
+    const sessionResult = await client.query(
+      `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_review_sessions WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`,
+      [sessionId],
+    );
+    if (!sessionResult.rowCount)
+      throw fail(404, "Review session is unavailable.");
+    const session = sessionResult.rows[0];
+    if (session.session_status !== "Draft")
+      throw fail(409, "This review has already been finalized.");
+    if (Number(session.draft_version) !== Number(expectedVersion))
+      throw fail(409, "Review draft changed in another session.", {
+        draftVersion: Number(session.draft_version),
+      });
+    const audit = (
+      await client.query(`SELECT * FROM atlas_audits WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, [
+        session.audit_id,
+      ])
+    ).rows[0];
+    if (!audit) throw fail(404, "Audit is unavailable.");
+    const request = (
+      await client.query(
+        `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_approval_requests WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2 FOR UPDATE`,
+        [session.approval_request_id, session.audit_id],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    if (
+      !request ||
+      request.request_status !== "Pending" ||
+      audit.workflow_status !== "Pending Approval" ||
+      Number(audit.current_approval_request_id) !== Number(request.id) ||
+      Number(request.submitted_revision_id) !==
+        Number(session.submitted_revision_id) ||
+      Number(audit.current_revision_id) !==
+        Number(session.submitted_revision_id)
+    )
+      throw fail(409, "The approval request is no longer current.");
+    await authority(client, {
+      auditId: session.audit_id,
+      requestId: session.approval_request_id,
+      user,
+      lock: false,
+    });
+    const submitted = (
+      await client.query(
+        `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_revisions WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2 FOR SHARE`,
+        [session.submitted_revision_id, session.audit_id],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    if (!submitted) throw fail(404, "Submitted revision is unavailable.");
+    const items = await sessionItems(client, sessionId);
+    const summary = finalSummary(items);
+    const threadSummary = await reviewThreadSummary(client, sessionId, {
+      lock: true,
+    });
+    summary.threadSummary = threadSummary;
+    summary.decisionEligible = summary.approvalEligible;
+    summary.approvalEligible =
+      summary.decisionEligible && threadSummary.eligible;
+    if (!summary.approvalEligible)
+      throw fail(
+        409,
+        threadSummary.eligible
+          ? "Every applicable review item must be approved."
+          : "Every applicable review discussion must be resolved before approval.",
+        {
+          finalSummary: summary,
+        },
+      );
+    const actor = reviewActor(user);
+    const approval = (
+      await client.query(
+        `INSERT INTO atlas_audit_approvals (audit_id,approved_revision_id,approval_request_id,approving_user_id,approving_username,reviewer_comments) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *`,
+        [
+          session.audit_id,
+          session.submitted_revision_id,
+          request.id,
+          actor.userId,
+          actor.username,
+          null,
+        ],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    const versionNumber = Number(
+      (
+        await client.query(
+          `SELECT COALESCE(max(version_number),0)::integer+1 AS next FROM atlas_audit_publications WHERE audit_id=$1`,
+          [session.audit_id],
+        )
+      ).rows[0].next,
+    );

+function stable(v) {
+  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(stable);
+  if (v && typeof v === "object")
+    return Object.keys(v)
+      .sort()
+      .reduce((o, k) => ((o[k] = stable(v[k])), o), {});
+  return v;
+}
+function documentHash(v) {
+  return createHash("sha256")
+    .update(JSON.stringify(stable(v)))
+    .digest("hex");
+}
+function normalizeAssignments(v) {
+  const a = v && typeof v === "object" ? v : {};
+  return {
+    assigned: Array.isArray(a.assigned) ? a.assigned : [],
+    backup: Array.isArray(a.backup) ? a.backup : [],
+    developer: Array.isArray(a.developer) ? a.developer : [],
+  };

+export async function invalidateWorkflowAuthorityWithClient(
+  c,
+  {
+    auditRow,
+    user,
+    reason,
+    restoration = false,
+    resultingRevisionId = null,
+    affectedStepId = null,
+    sourceStepRevisionId = null,

+    ["Pending Approval", "Approved", "Draft Revision"].includes(
+      auditRow.workflow_status,

+    restoration
+  ) {
+    await c.query(

+export async function rescindAuditApprovalRequest(
+  pool,
+  { auditId, requestId, expectedRevisionId, reason, user },
+) {
+  const rescindReason = clean(reason);
+  if (!rescindReason) throw fail(400, "A rescission reason is required.");
+  const id = Number(requestId);
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id <= 0)
+    throw fail(400, "Approval request identifier is invalid.");
+  return tx(pool, async (c) => {

+    revision(a, expectedRevisionId);

+      );

+      throw fail(409, "Approval request is no longer active.", {

+      [id, auditId, p.userId, p.username, rescindReason],

+async function decision(
+  pool,
+  {
+    auditId,
+    requestId,
+    expectedRevisionId,
+    response,
+    user,
+    verifyUser,
+    approved,
+  },
+) {
+  return tx(pool, async (c) => {
+    const a = await lockAudit(c, auditId);
+    revision(a, expectedRevisionId);
+    const q = await c.query(
+      `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_approval_requests WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2 FOR UPDATE`,
+      [requestId, auditId],
+    );
+    const req = q.rows[0];
+    if (
+      !req ||
+      req.request_status !== "Pending" ||
+      Number(a.current_approval_request_id) !== Number(requestId) ||
+      Number(req.submitted_revision_id) !== Number(a.current_revision_id)
+    )
+      throw fail(409, "The approval request is no longer current.", {
+        currentRequestId: a.current_approval_request_id,
+      });
+    const fresh = await verifyUser(user);
+    const context = {
+      selectedApprover: {
+        id: req.selected_approver_user_id,
+        username: req.selected_approver_username,
+      },
+      exactRevision: true,
+      exactRequest: true,
+    };
+    if (!auditAccessForUser(fresh, rowAudit(a), context).canApprove)
+      throw fail(403, "This user cannot decide the approval request.");
+    if (!approved && !clean(response))
+      throw fail(400, "A reviewer response is required when denying an audit.");
+    const p = actor(fresh);
+    await c.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audit_approval_requests SET request_status=$3,reviewer_response=$4,decision_actor_user_id=$5,decision_actor_username=$6,decision_at=current_timestamp,updated_at=current_timestamp WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2`,
+      [
+        requestId,
+        auditId,
+        approved ? "Approved" : "Denied",
+        clean(response) || null,
+        p.userId,
+        p.username,
+      ],
+    );
+    let approval = null;
+    if (approved) {
+      const x = await c.query(
+        `INSERT INTO atlas_audit_approvals (audit_id,approved_revision_id,approval_request_id,approving_user_id,approving_username,reviewer_comments) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *`,
+        [
+          auditId,
+          a.current_revision_id,
+          requestId,
+          p.userId,
+          p.username,
+          clean(response) || null,
+        ],
+      );
+      approval = x.rows[0];
+      await c.query(
+        `UPDATE atlas_audits SET workflow_status='Approved',current_approval_id=$2 WHERE id=$1`,
+        [auditId, approval.id],
+      );
+    } else
+      await c.query(
+        `UPDATE atlas_audits SET workflow_status='Draft',current_approval_request_id=NULL,current_approval_id=NULL WHERE id=$1`,
+        [auditId],
+      );
+    await resolveInboxItem(c, { auditId, requestId });
+    await inbox(c, {
+      recipient: {
+        id: req.requester_user_id,
+        username: req.requester_username,
+      },
+      auditId,
+      requestId,
+      type: "Approval Decision",
+      metadata: { decision: approved ? "Approved" : "Denied" },
+    });
+    await recordAuditActivityWithClient(
+      c,
+      auditId,
+      approved ? "approval.request_approved" : "approval.request_denied",
+      fresh,
+      {
+        requestId,
+        approvalId: approval?.id,
+        sourceRevisionId: Number(a.current_revision_id),
+      },
+    );
+    return {
+      workflowStatus: approved ? "Approved" : "Draft",
+      requestId: Number(requestId),
+      approval,
+    };
+  });

+      assign = normalizeAssignments(a.document.assignments);
+    const x = await c.query(
+      `INSERT INTO atlas_audit_publications (audit_id,version_number,version_title,description,change_summary,approved_revision_id,source_approval_id,source_working_revision_id,snapshot,snapshot_sha256,assignment_snapshot,approver_user_id,approver_username,publisher_user_id,publisher_username) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$6,$8::jsonb,$9,$10::jsonb,$11,$12,$13,$14) RETURNING *`,
+      [
+        auditId,
+        n,
+        clean(versionTitle),
+        clean(description) || null,
+        clean(changeSummary) || null,
+        a.current_revision_id,
+        ap.id,
+        JSON.stringify(a.document),
+        documentHash(a.document),
+        JSON.stringify(assign),
+        ap.approving_user_id,
+        ap.approving_username,
+        p.userId,
+        p.username,
+      ],
+    );
+    const pub = x.rows[0];
+    await c.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audits SET workflow_status='Published',current_publication_id=$2,published_locked=true,working_from_publication_id=NULL WHERE id=$1`,
+      [auditId, pub.id],
+    );
+    await recordAuditActivityWithClient(c, auditId, "audit.published", fresh, {
+      approvalId: ap.id,
+      publicationId: pub.id,
+      versionNumber: n,
+      sourceRevisionId: Number(a.current_revision_id),
+    });
+    return { publication: pub, workflowStatus: "Published" };
+  });
+}
+export async function unlockPublishedAudit(
+  pool,
+  {
+    auditId,
+    expectedRevisionId,
+    expectedPublicationId,
+    reason,
+    user,
+    verifyUser,
+  },
+) {
+  return tx(pool, async (c) => {
+    const a = await lockAudit(c, auditId);
+    revision(a, expectedRevisionId);
+    if (!clean(reason)) throw fail(400, "An unlock reason is required.");
+    if (
+      Number(a.current_publication_id) !== Number(expectedPublicationId) ||
+      a.workflow_status !== "Published"
+    )
+      throw fail(409, "The publication is no longer current.", {
+        currentPublicationId: a.current_publication_id,
+      });
+    const fresh = await verifyUser(user);
+    if (
+      !auditAccessForUser(fresh, rowAudit(a), { exactPublication: true })
+        .canUnlock
+    )
+      throw fail(403, "This user cannot unlock the audit.");
+    const sourceRevision = (
+      await c.query(
+        `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_revisions WHERE id=$1 AND audit_id=$2 FOR SHARE`,
+        [a.current_revision_id, auditId],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    if (!sourceRevision)
+      throw fail(409, "The current revision is unavailable.");
+    const nextRevisionNumber = Number(a.current_revision_number) + 1;
+    const who = actor(fresh);
+    const newRevision = (
+      await c.query(
+        `INSERT INTO atlas_audit_revisions (audit_id,revision_number,parent_revision_id,document,document_sha256,change_type,change_summary,created_by_user_id,created_by_username,created_by_full_name,created_by_email) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,$5,'unlock',$6,$7,$8,$8,NULL) RETURNING id,revision_number`,
+        [
+          auditId,
+          nextRevisionNumber,
+          a.current_revision_id,
+          JSON.stringify(sourceRevision.document),
+          sourceRevision.document_sha256,
+          clean(reason),
+          who.userId,
+          who.username,
+        ],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    await c.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audits SET current_revision_id=$2,current_revision_number=$3,workflow_status='Draft Revision',published_locked=false,working_from_publication_id=current_publication_id,current_approval_request_id=NULL,current_approval_id=NULL,revision_cycle_number=revision_cycle_number+1 WHERE id=$1`,
+      [auditId, newRevision.id, newRevision.revision_number],
+    );
+    await recordAuditActivityWithClient(
+      c,
+      auditId,
+      "audit.published_unlocked",
+      fresh,
+      {
+        publicationId: Number(expectedPublicationId),
+        versionNumber: (
+          await c.query(
+            `SELECT version_number FROM atlas_audit_publications WHERE id=$1`,
+            [expectedPublicationId],
+          )
+        ).rows[0].version_number,
+        reason: clean(reason) || null,
+      },
+    );
+    return {
+      auditId,
+      workflowStatus: "Draft Revision",
+      workingFromPublicationId: Number(expectedPublicationId),
+      currentRevisionId: Number(newRevision.id),
+      revisionNumber: Number(newRevision.revision_number),
+    };
+  });
+}
+export async function softDeleteAuditPublication(
+  pool,
+  {
+    auditId,
+    versionNumber,
+    expectedPublicationId,
+    expectedRevisionId,
+    confirmation,
+    reason,
+    user,
+  },
+) {
+  if (confirmation !== true)
+    throw fail(400, "Explicit confirmation is required.");
+  if (!clean(reason)) throw fail(400, "A deletion reason is required.");
+  return tx(pool, async (c) => {
+    const a = await lockAudit(c, auditId);
+    if (!auditAccessForUser(user, rowAudit(a)).canDeletePublication)
+      throw fail(403, "The atlas-align-admin role is required.");
+    if (Number(a.current_revision_id) !== Number(expectedRevisionId))
+      throw fail(409, "The audit revision is stale.", {
+        currentRevisionId: Number(a.current_revision_id),
+      });
+    const p = (
+      await c.query(
+        `SELECT * FROM atlas_audit_publications WHERE audit_id=$1 AND version_number=$2 FOR UPDATE`,
+        [auditId, versionNumber],
+      )
+    ).rows[0];
+    if (!p) throw fail(404, "Publication not found.");
+    if (
+      p.deletion_status !== "Active" ||
+      Number(p.id) !== Number(expectedPublicationId)
+    )
+      throw fail(409, "The publication lifecycle state is stale.", {
+        currentPublicationId: p.id,
+      });
+    const u = actor(user);
+    await c.query(
+      `UPDATE atlas_audit_publications SET deletion_status='Recently Deleted',deleted_at=current_timestamp,deleted_by_user_id=$3,deleted_by_username=$4,deletion_reason=$5 WHERE audit_id=$1 AND id=$2`,
+      [auditId, p.id, u.userId, u.username, clean(reason)],
+    );
+    await recordAuditActivityWithClient(
+      c,
+      auditId,
+      "publication.sent_to_recently_deleted",
+      user,
+      {
+        publicationId: p.id,
+        versionNumber: p.version_number,
+        reason: clean(reason),
+      },
+    );
+    return {
+      auditId,
+      versionNumber: Number(versionNumber),
+      deletionStatus: "Recently Deleted",
+    };
+  });
+}
+export async function listAuditPublications(
+  pool,
+  { auditId, user, limit = 50, lifecycle = "Active" },
+) {
+  const a = await getAuditWorkflowSummary(pool, { auditId, user });
+  if (!a.capabilities.canViewHistory)
+    throw fail(403, "Audit history access is required.");
+  const deletionStatus =
+    lifecycle === "Recently Deleted" ? "Recently Deleted" : "Active";
+  if (
+    deletionStatus === "Recently Deleted" &&
+    !a.capabilities.canDeletePublication
+  )
+    throw fail(403, "The atlas-align-admin role is required.");
+  const r = await pool.query(
+    `SELECT p.id,p.audit_id AS "auditId",a.name AS "auditName",p.version_number AS "versionNumber",p.version_title AS "versionTitle",p.description,p.change_summary AS "changeSummary",p.publisher_username AS "publisherUsername",p.published_at AS "publishedAt",p.deletion_status AS "deletionStatus",p.deleted_at AS "deletedAt",p.deleted_by_username AS "deletedByUsername",p.deletion_reason AS "deletionReason" FROM atlas_audit_publications p JOIN atlas_audits a ON a.id=p.audit_id WHERE p.audit_id=$1 AND p.deletion_status=$2 ORDER BY p.version_number DESC LIMIT $3`,
+    [auditId, deletionStatus, Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number(limit) || 50))],
+  );
+  return r.rows;
+}

+export async function getAuditWorkflowSummary(pool, { auditId, user }) {
+  const r = await pool.query(

+    [auditId],
+  );
+  if (!r.rowCount) throw fail(404, "Audit not found.");

+      : null,
+    workingFromPublicationId: a.working_from_publication_id
+      ? Number(a.working_from_publication_id)

+export async function getInboxApprovalReviewContext(pool, { itemId, user }) {
+  const id = Number(itemId);
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id <= 0)
+    throw fail(400, "Inbox item identifier is invalid.");
+  const result = await pool.query(
+    `SELECT i.id AS "inboxItemId",i.audit_id AS "auditId",i.approval_request_id AS "requestId",
+      i.item_status AS "itemStatus",q.request_status AS "requestStatus",
+      q.submitted_revision_id AS "submittedRevisionId",a.current_revision_id AS "currentRevisionId",
+      a.current_approval_request_id AS "currentRequestId",a.workflow_status AS "workflowStatus",
+      q.selected_approver_user_id AS "selectedApproverUserId",
+      q.selected_approver_username AS "selectedApproverUsername",rev.document
+     FROM atlas_inbox_items i
+     JOIN atlas_audit_approval_requests q ON q.id=i.approval_request_id AND q.audit_id=i.audit_id
+     JOIN atlas_audits a ON a.id=i.audit_id AND a.archived_at IS NULL
+     JOIN atlas_audit_revisions rev ON rev.id=q.submitted_revision_id AND rev.audit_id=q.audit_id
+     WHERE i.id=$1 AND (i.recipient_user_id=$2 OR
+       (i.recipient_user_id IS NULL AND lower(i.recipient_username)=lower($3)))`,
+    [id, user.id, user.username],
+  );
+  if (!result.rowCount)
+    throw fail(404, "Inbox approval request was not found or is unavailable.");
+  const row = result.rows[0];
+  if (
+    row.itemStatus !== "Actionable" ||
+    row.requestStatus !== "Pending" ||
+    row.workflowStatus !== "Pending Approval" ||
+    Number(row.currentRequestId) !== Number(row.requestId)
+  )
+    throw fail(409, "This approval request is no longer actionable.", {
+      currentRequestId: row.currentRequestId,
+    });
+  const selectedApprover = {
+    id: row.selectedApproverUserId,
+    username: row.selectedApproverUsername,
+  };
+  if (
+    !auditAccessForUser(
+      user,
+      { ...row.document, workflowStatus: row.workflowStatus },
+      {
+        selectedApprover,
+        exactRevision: true,
+        exactRequest: true,
+      },
+    ).canApprove
+  )
+    throw fail(
+      403,
+      "This approval request is not assigned to the signed-in user.",
+    );
+  return {
+    inboxItemId: Number(row.inboxItemId),
+    auditId: row.auditId,
+    requestId: Number(row.requestId),
+    submittedRevisionId: Number(row.submittedRevisionId),
+    currentRevisionId: Number(row.currentRevisionId),
+  };
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import test from "node:test";
+import vm from "node:vm";
+
+function functionSource(source, name) {
+  const start = source.indexOf(`function ${name}(`);
+  assert.notEqual(start, -1, `${name} must exist`);
+  const brace = source.indexOf(") {", start) + 2;
+  let depth = 0;
+  for (let index = brace; index < source.length; index += 1) {
+    if (source[index] === "{") depth += 1;
+    if (source[index] === "}") depth -= 1;
+    if (depth === 0) return source.slice(start, index + 1);
+  }
+  throw new Error(`Could not extract ${name}`);
+}

-- `ATLAS_USER_IMPERSONATION_ENABLED` is the fail-closed environment flag for the feature.
-- `src/user-impersonation.js` owns opaque-token hashing, PostgreSQL-backed browser sessions, expiration, renewal, invalidation, and effective-profile construction.
-- `server.js` preserves the StudioShare identity as `req.authenticatedStudioshareUser` and exposes the server-validated effective identity as `req.studioshareUser`.
-- `.launch/migrations/20260914170000_add_user_impersonation.sql` adds profile email and role snapshots, browser-scoped impersonation sessions, and authenticated-actor activity attribution.
-- `js/16a-user-impersonation.js` owns the topbar profile picker, role filters, switch confirmation, countdown, renewal, and return-to-profile interactions. It is a classic script loaded immediately after `js/16-page-shell.js`.
-- Root `styles.css` remains generated output; impersonation source styles are owned by `css/global.css`.
-- Impersonation lifecycle events are server-log-only. Audit activity keeps the effective actor in existing actor fields and stores the authenticated actor in additive nullable columns.
-
-### Impersonation Profile Role Refresh
-
-- `src/studioshare-role-refresh.js` owns server-side StudioShare user and role retrieval for persisted impersonation profiles, nested user-role normalization, bounded concurrency, freshness checks, rate-limit-aware scheduling, and safe failure classification.
-- The real authenticated request token is used for `GET /core/users/{id}` and `GET /core/users/{id}/roles`; the effective impersonated profile never owns or receives that token.
-- `.launch/migrations/20260914183000_add_user_profile_role_resolution.sql` adds nullable `last_role_resolved_at` and `role_resolution_status` fields. Recognized statuses are `resolved`, `resolved_empty`, `unavailable`, `forbidden`, and `not_found`.
-- A successful role lookup replaces `role_slugs` and records a verified status. A failed lookup preserves the previous `role_slugs` and records only the failure status.
-- Impersonation candidate listing refreshes only stale or unverified profiles with concurrency limited to three. Verified snapshots remain fresh for 15 minutes.
-- Starting and renewing impersonation revalidate the selected effective profile before a session is established or extended.
-
-##### Request-bound Inbox Approval Review Contract
-
-- `GET /api/inbox/:itemId/approval-review` validates the authenticated Inbox recipient, actionable Inbox status, Pending and current approval request, selected approver, audit/request/revision relationships, and submitted revision before returning a detached read-only review model.
-- `ATLASWorkflow.showApprovalReview(mode, context)` accepts explicit audit and request identity. Inbox callers also provide the Inbox item identifier; that identity is not derived from or replaced by the active editable audit.
-- Approval review responses include the semantic comparison and a detached submitted-revision document. A no-differences result remains inspectable and does not apply the document to `state.audit` or enter recovery, autosave, dirty-state, revision, or durable-write paths.
-- Inbox and shared approval-review generation guards ensure a stale response cannot replace the most recently selected review.
-- New named functions: `getInboxApprovalReviewContext()`, `atlasApprovalReviewContext()`, `atlasWorkflowPreviewRequest()`, and `atlasShowApprovalReview()`.
-
-###### Feature 2A Review Data Model and Read-only Review Mode Contract
-
-- `.launch/migrations/20260914200000_add_audit_review_sessions_and_items.sql` adds request/revision/reviewer-bound draft review sessions and deterministic review items. Decisions are constrained to Approve, Request changes, and Needs discussion; note requirements apply to non-approval decisions and accepted warnings.
-- `src/audit-review-repository.js` owns deterministic review-item construction, session create/resume, optimistic draft concurrency, progress derivation, item decision persistence, and atomic section bulk approval.
-- `js/27-audit-review-mode.js` owns the detached read-only review workspace. It renders the submitted revision model and review decisions without applying content to `state.audit` or calling audit capture, recovery, autosave, revision, restoration, or durable-write paths.
-- Review item identity uses canonical overview paths, source keys, stable step IDs, canonical Display Field keys, one full-sequence Display Field order key, and canonical Audit Issue stable keys. Generated Reference steps reflect linked source decisions and are not direct decision records.
-- Feature 2A records draft review work only. It does not approve, deny, return, publish, complete, lock, or unlock an audit.
-- New named backend functions: `buildAuditReviewItems()`, `openAuditReview()`, `getAuditReview()`, `saveAuditReview()`, and `bulkApproveAuditReview()`.
-- New browser API: `ATLASAuditReview.open()`, `ATLASAuditReview.close()`, `ATLASAuditReview.isActive()`, and `ATLASAuditReview.document()`.
-
-######## Feature 2B Final Review Return and Carry-forward Contract
-
-- `.launch/migrations/20260914213000_add_audit_review_return_and_carry_forward.sql` adds immutable returned-review finalization metadata, analyst recipient identity, review-cycle lineage, carry-forward provenance, and one returned-work Inbox projection per review session.
-- `returnAuditReview()` locks the review session, authoritative request, and audit; recalculates eligibility; finalizes the session as Returned; closes the request as Denied without adding a Rejected workflow state; moves the audit to Draft Revision; records activity; and creates the assigned analyst Inbox projection in one transaction.
-- `getAuditReviewFinalSummary()` derives approval and return eligibility from authoritative direct review items. Successful approval and publication remain outside Feature 2B.
-- `carryForwardReviewItemsWithClient()` carries only Approve decisions whose section, type, stable key, semantic fingerprint, parent/link identity, and applicable order/severity metadata match. Logic reorder resets review. Ambiguous, changed, removed, non-approved, and new items do not inherit approval.
-- Historical returned sessions and item comments remain unchanged. New-cycle items record source review-item provenance rather than copying historical comments into editable notes.
-- `GET /api/review-sessions/:sessionId/returned-feedback` permits the historical reviewer or returned analyst to retrieve returned comments. `js/25-inbox.js` opens Returned Review items by review-session identity.
-- New named functions: `getAuditReviewFinalSummary()`, `returnAuditReview()`, `getReturnedReviewFeedback()`, `carryForwardReviewItemsWithClient()`, `finalSummary()`, `assignedAnalyst()`, `sessionItems()`, and `carryEquivalent()`.
-
-######## Feature 2C Atomic Approval, Publication, Locking, and Inbox Contract
-
-- `.launch/migrations/20260914230000_add_audit_review_approval_finalization.sql` adds the terminal Approved review-session outcome, and aligns Inbox item types with the existing Returned Review projection.
-- `finalizeApprovedAuditReview()` owns the successful item-review finalization transaction. It locks the review session, audit, request, and submitted revision in a documented order; revalidates request/revision/reviewer authority and authoritative review completeness; records the approval; creates the immutable publication from the stored submitted revision; finalizes the review session; sets the audit to Published with its current approval/publication pointers and published lock; resolves the approver Inbox item; creates the requester decision projection; and records activity before commit.
-- The user-facing completion label is Complete, while the relational workflow state remains Published and the request/review outcomes remain Approved. No new workflow state is introduced.
-- `unlockPublishedAudit()` now requires a nonblank reason and creates an additive Draft Revision cloned from the current approved revision before releasing the published lock. The current publication remains immutable and current while `working_from_publication_id` records the revision source. `revision_cycle_number` begins the new approval cycle; formal submission still creates the next request through the established approver-selection flow.
-- `listInboxItems()` supplies server-backed sender and workflow-status context. `js/25-inbox.js`, `sections/inbox.html`, and `css/inbox.css` render an accessible responsive card grid with unread text/dot/border, status badges, sender/message content, and synchronized count targets. Read state remains separate from actionable resolution.
-- New named backend functions: `reviewActor()` and `finalizeApprovedAuditReview()`.

-###### Structured Approval Review Repair Contract
-
-- `saveAuditReview()` validates request-bound draft changes, uses an atomic `draft_version` compare-and-set update, returns typed 400/403/404/409 failures for expected conditions, and releases its transaction client before refreshing the review through the pool.

-- `css/audit-review.css` owns review landing, detail, decision, responsive, reduced-motion, and forced-colors presentation. It is loaded explicitly until a complete CSS source set is available for manifest generation.

-#### Package 2D.1 Canonical Object and Change Model Contract
-
-- `src/audit-comparison.js` owns canonical audit-scoped review objects, identity version 2, deterministic semantic fingerprints, shared comparison matching, deleted-object detection, Logic hierarchy validation, descendant invalidation, reason codes, and concise generated summaries.
-- `buildCanonicalAuditObjects()` creates stable identities for overview properties, assignments, canonical sources, persisted Logic step IDs, linked non-direct generated References, Display Field inclusion, the complete Display Field sequence, and canonical Audit Issues. Mutable labels and visible numbering are not identities.
-- `classifyCanonicalChanges()` compares an authoritative prior submitted revision with the current submitted revision. Without a valid prior returned-review baseline it creates the initial object set and does not invent deletions.
-- Display Field inclusion fingerprints exclude persisted position. One audit-scoped `display-order` object fingerprints the complete canonical sequence, so moves, additions, and removals reset order review without resetting unchanged inclusion review.
-- Supported removed sources, direct Logic steps, nested direct Logic steps, and Display Fields become direct deleted candidates. Generated Reference steps never become independent deleted decisions.
-- Material Logic content, parent, or established reorder changes reset that item. Parent changes add `ancestor_changed` to every direct descendant while unrelated branches remain eligible.
-- Review-session creation derives change metadata from the latest prior Returned review session for the same audit. Carry-forward remains Approve-only, matches audit-scoped canonical identity, uses item-type-specific equivalence, rejects changed, deleted, new, ambiguous, severity/applicability-changed, parent-changed, and ancestor-invalidated objects, records provenance, and never copies reviewer notes.
-- `.launch/migrations/20260915150000_add_canonical_review_object_metadata.sql` adds nullable legacy-compatible identity metadata, deletion state, deterministic change metadata, and bounded prior/submitted summaries to review items. Existing review rows remain readable without rewriting historical decisions.
-- Comparison audit responses remain additive and expose `canonical.identityVersion` plus canonical objects under comparison contract version 2. Step-only comparison remains contract version 1.
-- New named backend functions: `buildCanonicalAuditObjects()` and `classifyCanonicalChanges()`.
-
-##### Package 2D.2 Persistent Object Discussions Contract
-
-- `.launch/migrations/20260915170000_add_persistent_audit_review_discussions.sql` adds separate durable review-object, review-item relationship, discussion-thread, immutable-message, and immutable-transition records. Existing `reviewer_note` values are not read, copied, normalized, or rewritten.
-- `src/audit-discussion-repository.js` owns discussion reads and writes. It uses Package 2D.1 `canonical_object_key` plus `identity_version`, never mutable labels, to reuse one audit-scoped durable review object and one persistent thread across review cycles.
-- Every new canonical review item is linked to a durable review object during `openAuditReview()` in the same transaction. Legacy review items without canonical identity remain readable and do not receive fabricated relationships.
-- One persistent thread is allowed per durable review object. The thread continues across later review cycles for that canonical object. Replaced identities do not inherit the thread.
-- The selected reviewer may create a thread and add messages while an associated review is Draft or Returned. After a review for the object is Approved, the thread is read-only.
-- Any user in the current audit revision's Assigned Analyst collection may reply after the object has a Returned review lineage. Inbox ownership is not authority. Analysts cannot resolve or reopen.
-- Resolved threads reject new messages until the reviewer reopens them. Resolve and reopen use optimistic `state_version` concurrency and append immutable transition rows.
-- Open or resolved thread state does not independently affect return or approval eligibility. Discussion state never changes a review decision, `reviewer_note`, or `draft_version`; review decisions never change thread state.
-- Deleted canonical objects follow the same Draft/Returned write rules and become read-only after approval.
-- Message and transition attribution stores effective actor and authenticated actor identities separately. Routes pass only server-resolved identities from `req.studioshareUser` and `req.authenticatedStudioshareUser`.
-- Authorized reads are no-store and mutation free. Ordinary APIs expose creation, append, resolve, and reopen only; no message or transition edit/delete APIs exist.
-- New named backend functions: `ensureReviewObjectLinksWithClient()`, `getReviewItemDiscussions()`, `createReviewDiscussion()`, `addDiscussionMessage()`, `resolveDiscussion()`, and `reopenDiscussion()`.
-
-###### Package 2D.3 Existing-page Reviewer Mode Contract
-
-- `js/27-audit-review-mode.js` replaces the primary landing dialog with a request-bound existing-page review shell. It owns one transient model, floating progress, page density, stoplight decisions, filters, changed/deleted summaries, stable-target navigation, discussion-panel lifecycle, generation guards, and exit cleanup.
-- `atlasDisplayDocument()`, `atlasReviewerModeDocument()`, `atlasIsReviewerMode()`, and `atlasReviewerModeContext()` expose the detached display contract without assigning submitted content to editable `state.audit`.
-- Existing Audit Overview, Sources, Logic Builder, Display Fields, and Audit Issues page hosts receive additive review adapters keyed by server-provided review-item identity. Non-direct generated References remain reflected. Deleted candidates use dedicated stable entries.
-- Logic review navigation uses stable item identity and `atlasRevealLogicStep()` before scrolling and focus so collapsed, virtualized descendants can be mounted safely.
-- `js/04-persistence.js` and `js/18-audit-database.js` fail closed for ordinary recovery, autosave, durable write, page-hide save, and archive paths while Reviewer Mode is active. Review-decision and Package 2D.2 discussion APIs remain separate.
-- `css/audit-review.css` owns Reviewer Mode shell, progress, density, stoplights, review cards, deleted summaries, thread panel, responsive behavior, reduced-motion behavior, and forced-colors behavior. Root `styles.css` remains the deployable generated compatibility artifact.
-- Stage 2 completes the existing Reviewer Mode HUD with authoritative review progress, final-action entry points, accessible collapse/restore, viewport-constrained dragging, and effective-user-scoped local presentation preferences. HUD preferences contain only collapsed state and position and never enter audit, revision, review, decision, or discussion persistence.
-- Reviewer Mode cards display server-provided prior/submitted summaries, change classifications/reason codes, canonical identity attributes, discussion state/counts when supplied, and explicit non-direct generated Reference presentation.
-- New named Reviewer Mode helpers: preferenceKey(), clampHudPosition(), loadHudPreferences(), saveHudPreferences(), and applyHudState().
-- Phase 2 workflow alignment keeps Reviewer Mode audit/request/revision/session-bound, suppresses ordinary active-audit workflow-summary refresh while detached review content is displayed, and exposes one adaptive final action derived from the server final summary and public feature availability.
-- Review draft saves preserve decisions made while a prior save is in flight. Final-summary responses include the same safe public workflow feature projection used by server route guards.
-- New named Reviewer Mode helpers: reviewContextIsCurrent(), adaptiveFinalAction(), and refreshFinalSummary().
-- Package 2D.1 change summaries and deleted metadata are displayed without browser-generated comparison rules. Package 2D.2 messages and state remain server-authorized and independent from review decisions.
-- Stage 3 discussion reads expose server-derived per-session UI capabilities for create, reply, resolve, reopen, and approved read-only presentation. Review-item responses include additive authoritative discussion state and message counts, while decision and draft concurrency remain independent.
-- Stage 3 Inbox cards render available review counts from display_metadata and use browser-only workflow labels. Relational workflow states, request outcomes, API fields, and database values remain unchanged.
-- New named Inbox display helpers: workflowLabel() and reviewCounts().
-
-####### Package 2D.4 Return, Feedback, and Finalization Contract
-
-- Early Send Back reuses the atomic Returned transaction and permits undecided direct items only when at least one direct item has Request changes or Needs discussion and all required notes are valid.
-- Returned review decisions and open discussion blockers are projected as Review Feedback separately from canonical Audit Issues.
-- Assigned analysts receive a capability-limited in-context feedback mode and may append authorized thread messages without reviewer decision or thread-state authority.
-- Final summary and final approval validate applicable persistent discussion threads separately from item decisions. Finalization locks discussion threads before creating approval and publication and fails while any applicable direct-object thread is Open.
-
-#### Approval Review Opening and Generated Reference Repair Contract
-
-- `atlasShowApprovalReview()` resolves the active workflow summary before opening Reviewer Mode when the Audit Overview action does not supply explicit request context. `ATLASAuditReview.open()` validates either a review-session identity or an audit/request identity before constructing an API route.
-- `src/audit-comparison.js` resolves generated Reference source links through the selected source's stable key and its supported alternate identities. Alternate identities are lookup-only, ambiguous aliases fail closed, and generated References remain non-direct while linking to the canonical Source object.
-- Reviewer Mode draft saves send the established `changes` payload with `sectionKey` and `stableItemKey`; they do not use review-item database IDs as the write contract.
-
-### Pending Approval Lock and Rescission Contract
-
-- While an audit is in `Pending Approval`, ordinary audit-document mutation is locked for every user. The submitted revision remains the current revision until approval completes, the reviewer returns the audit, or a current Assigned Analyst rescinds the request.
-- `rescindAuditApprovalRequest()` is the server-authoritative transactional operation for analyst withdrawal. It requires the exact current request and revision, records `approval.request_rescinded`, resolves actionable Inbox projections, closes any Draft review session as `Rescinded`, and restores `Draft` or `Draft Revision` from persisted publication lineage.
-- `assertAuditDocumentMutationAllowed()` rejects ordinary saves and restorations during `Pending Approval` with the typed `AUDIT_PENDING_APPROVAL_LOCKED` conflict before a revision is inserted or workflow authority is invalidated.
-- The browser uses `atlasAuditIsWorkflowLocked()` to apply read-only controls for both `Pending Approval` and `Published`, while preserving distinct guidance and available workflow actions.
-- Workflow-locked controls are reapplied after dynamic Sources and Logic Builder renders. A single body-level tooltip is positioned against the focused or hovered locked control, flips or clamps within viewport margins, remains above clipping containers, and repositions on scroll or resize. Named browser helpers are `atlasEnsureWorkflowLockTooltip()`, `atlasPositionWorkflowLockTooltip()`, `atlasShowWorkflowLockTooltip()`, `atlasHideWorkflowLockTooltip()`, `atlasInstallWorkflowRenderHook()`, and `atlasInstallWorkflowMutationGuard()`.
-- Migration `20260915190000_add_rescinded_approval_request_state.sql` adds the `Rescinded` request/session lifecycle and dedicated rescission attribution. Rollback is intentionally blocked when Rescinded records exist.

+WITH candidates AS (
+       SELECT i.id AS review_item_id,s.audit_id,i.canonical_object_key,i.identity_version,i.item_type,i.display_label,
+         jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('isDeleted',i.is_deleted,'changeType',i.change_type,'prior',i.prior_object_summary,'submitted',i.submitted_object_summary)) AS metadata
+       FROM atlas_audit_review_items i JOIN atlas_audit_review_sessions s ON s.id=i.review_session_id
+       WHERE s.id=$1 AND i.canonical_object_key IS NOT NULL AND i.identity_version IS NOT NULL
+     ), objects AS (
+       INSERT INTO atlas_audit_review_objects(audit_id,canonical_object_key,identity_version,item_type,display_label,object_metadata)
+       SELECT DISTINCT audit_id,canonical_object_key,identity_version,item_type,display_label,metadata FROM candidates
+       ON CONFLICT(audit_id,canonical_object_key,identity_version) DO UPDATE SET
+         display_label=EXCLUDED.display_label,object_metadata=EXCLUDED.object_metadata
+       RETURNING id,audit_id,canonical_object_key,identity_version
+     )
+     INSERT INTO atlas_audit_review_item_objects(review_item_id,review_object_id,audit_id)
+     SELECT c.review_item_id,o.id,c.audit_id FROM candidates c
+     JOIN atlas_audit_review_objects o ON o.audit_id=c.audit_id AND o.canonical_object_key=c.canonical_object_key AND o.identity_version=c.identity_version
+     ON CONFLICT(review_item_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING review_item_id

+SELECT t.id AS thread_id,t.audit_id,t.current_state,t.state_version,o.id AS review_object_id,
+      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atlas_audit_review_item_objects io JOIN atlas_audit_review_items i ON i.id=io.review_item_id
+        JOIN atlas_audit_review_sessions s ON s.id=i.review_session_id
+        WHERE io.review_object_id=o.id AND io.audit_id=o.audit_id AND s.session_status IN ('Draft','Returned')
+          AND (lower(s.reviewer_username)=lower($2) OR s.reviewer_user_id=$3)) AS current_reviewer,
+      (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atlas_audit_review_item_objects io JOIN atlas_audit_review_items i ON i.id=io.review_item_id
+        JOIN atlas_audit_review_sessions s ON s.id=i.review_session_id
+        WHERE io.review_object_id=o.id AND io.audit_id=o.audit_id AND s.session_status='Returned')
+       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atlas_audits a JOIN atlas_audit_revisions r ON r.id=a.current_revision_id AND r.audit_id=a.id,
+         LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(r.document->'assignments'->'assigned','[]'::jsonb)) assigned
+         WHERE a.id=o.audit_id AND (lower(COALESCE(assigned->>'username',assigned->>'email',assigned->>'login',''))=lower($2)
+           OR (NULLIF($3,'') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(assigned->>'id',assigned->>'userId','')=$3)))) AS current_analyst,
+      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atlas_audit_review_item_objects io JOIN atlas_audit_review_items i ON i.id=io.review_item_id
+        JOIN atlas_audit_review_sessions s ON s.id=i.review_session_id
+        WHERE io.review_object_id=o.id AND io.audit_id=o.audit_id AND s.session_status='Approved') AS approved
+     FROM atlas_audit_discussion_threads t
+     JOIN atlas_audit_review_objects o ON o.id=t.review_object_id AND o.audit_id=t.audit_id
+     WHERE t.id=$1 FOR UPDATE OF t

+/** Loads a UTF-8 SQL resource relative to the calling module URL. */
+export function loadSql(relativePath, moduleUrl) {
+  return readFileSync(new URL(relativePath, moduleUrl), "utf8");
+}
